name: Nvim development (prerelease) build
body:
```
NVIM v0.13.0-dev-1892+g9b7ec59580
Build type: RelWithDebInfo
LuaJIT 2.1.1791988261
```

## Release notes

- [Changelog](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/commit/9b7ec59580fddf671f7bf922f66ef114a59a51ee) (fixes + features)
- [News](./runtime/doc/news.txt) (`:help news` in Nvim)

## Install

### Windows

#### Zip

1. Download **nvim-win64.zip** (or **nvim-win-arm64.zip** for ARM)
2. Extract the zip
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

#### MSI

1. Download **nvim-win64.msi** (or **nvim-win-arm64.msi** for ARM)
2. Run the MSI
3. Run `nvim.exe` in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to [install `vcruntime*.dll`](https://neovim.io/doc/install/#windows).

### macOS (x86_64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### macOS (arm64)

1. Download **nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Run `xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz` (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
3. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz`
4. Run `./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) [builds for older glibc](https://github.com/neovim/neovim-releases).

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim`

### Linux (arm64)

#### AppImage

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.appimage**
2. Run `chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage`
   - If your system does not have FUSE you can [extract the appimage](https://github.com/AppImage/AppImageKit/wiki/FUSE#type-2-appimage):
     ```bash
     ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
     ./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim
     ```

#### Tarball

1. Download **nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz**
2. Extract: `tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz`
3. Run `./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim`

### Other

- Install by [package manager](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/master/INSTALL.md#install-from-package)

name: v0.8.168
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.168

Released on 2026-10-17.

Scrubbing back across a scene in the preview now shows its content instead of an empty frame. Cloud renders size their chunks to the worker limit and assemble in one pass, so long videos finish faster.

## Features

- **Producer:** Distributed renders accept 25 fps ([cc9e1bb33a4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/cc9e1bb33a430b878af6dcb257ce5c9a70f9f180), [#5423](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5423)).
- **Producer:** Render at 720p and 480p from a larger composition ([09c0307c3fd](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/09c0307c3fd0318a7ea77e6b41df4e5d30a1902b), [#5724](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5724)).

## Fixes

- **Core:** Scrubbing back across a scene no longer leaves its content hidden ([4cf0e3a0e59](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4cf0e3a0e599c73a9a96efcee8f62099323a08cf), [#5766](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5766)).
- **Engine:** Local renders lay out width-only videos like the browser ([fc41fa277a5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fc41fa277a5649eb4879b524192dd6bee39d7465), [#5771](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5771)).
- **CLI:** A browser a sandbox refuses says to rerun the command with escalation ([fa936691562](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/fa9366915620ea9baa1d03b0eb44caaca013dc21), [#5734](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5734)).
- **CLI:** Check's dense overlap pass takes at most 240 samples, at clip windows first ([caea3863b07](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/caea3863b075f5f79d1c77dd084d05ea05aa0529), [#5764](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5764)).
- **Lint:** Stop flagging dir on <html>; a render test now guards RTL export ([e6ce7337962](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/e6ce73379620fb2abf73e0ab681e85fd7f938725), [#5744](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5744)).
- **Skills:** Regenerate manifest after HyperFrames guidance update ([40c64255e8c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/40c64255e8c0a3d11a0d6e8229b7a88877c84401), [#5747](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5747)).
- **CLI:** Honour HYPERFRAMES_SKIP_SKILLS in skills update and bare skills ([6dba67a0c3a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/6dba67a0c3a0a51247ab85bbc245f1cf3effa0dc), [#5743](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5743)).
- **CLI:** Timeline lists clips nested in a timed element and lint flags ones that never show ([eab6ca15b1a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eab6ca15b1af7ec7bca0bbeb4cd0330e677467a5), [#5732](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5732)).
- **Engine:** A WebGPU block mounted as a sub-composition gets WebGPU like a root one ([4e6ee6d2300](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/4e6ee6d2300290b638042ec88ef5afb7a0c27408), [#5735](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5735)).
- **Core:** A composition mounted twice keeps each mount's own timeline ([c38e9f350b4](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c38e9f350b4dbe6b09a6a35d5db0d437b9464220), [#5729](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5729)).

## Performance

- **Producer:** Assemble in one pass and keep its disk use under one output copy ([a498cf2032c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/a498cf2032c6b22492dedb475ad6196a8d6c6797), [#5768](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5768)).
- **Producer:** Size distributed chunks to the worker limit and concurrency ([c69fd2c6eca](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/c69fd2c6ecadedff88cdc09d37854a658bffb733), [#5765](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5765)).

## Internal

- **Core:** One owner for the distributed fps set ([d5162beb50a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d5162beb50a402a69423df106647347bd0f8763e), [#5756](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5756)).

## Full changelog

https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/compare/v0.8.167...v0.8.168

name: v0.8.167
body:
# HyperFrames v0.8.167

Released on 2026-10-16.

Long projects preview more smoothly: the preview's work now follows what is playing, not the total clip count. Bundling a project also stops freezing the app that runs it.

## Fixes

- **Core:** Bundling a project no longer blocks the host's thread on esbuild ([b1cf6e3c517](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/b1cf6e3c517e227d1dca1b212e7637c19e502a64), [#5714](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5714)).
- **CLI:** Page loads stop timing out while a busy machine's Chrome warms up ([41486b9725a](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/41486b9725ab2aae4f457d75dcd625931d103bb3), [#5705](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5705)).

## Performance

- **Core:** Hold a clip at 0 inside a later scene until it is due ([13ea8349597](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/13ea8349597bbcb874402d1771aea65766fd7ffc), [#5716](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5716)).
- **Core:** A preview's composition scripts give the page a turn every 50 ms, not one long task ([12d8df37f4d](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/12d8df37f4db8ccf019da32c97cc1352f8db9652), [#5713](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5713)).
- **Lint:** Strip stylesheet comments once per canvas zoom scan ([0bff8342c38](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/0bff8342c389c1841d3b8d858168700f13627e48), [#5712](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5712)).
- **Core:** Preview runtime scales with what plays, not with the film's clip count ([d05bc4215d5](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/d05bc4215d5757da86956217f4a8a4b2ab11b1fd), [#5674](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5674)).

## Internal

- **CLI:** Caption image test checks the close itself, not a reusable file number ([eace3d28b6c](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/commit/eace3d28b6cb721ec1f9a96d7d2ea76bf215551a), [#5707](https://github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes/pull/5707)).

## Full changelog

name: V3.17.6 Clearance
body:
Pake V3.17.6

Turn any webpage into a desktop app with one command.

### Changelog 1. With a hidden title bar on macOS, the logo and sidebar buttons of ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, and DeepSeek now sit clear of the traffic lights, with the sidebar open or collapsed. 2. Built-in style tweaks now load only on the site they were written for, so an app you package no longer inherits rules meant for other sites, such as a hidden footer or flattened lists. 3. On macOS, pressing Enter to confirm a Chinese or Japanese input method candidate no longer sends a half-typed message in chat boxes like X and Grok. 4. Notifications on Windows now play the system sound, and stay quiet only when the page asks for a silent notification. 5. Linux deb and rpm packages now install one launcher instead of two with the same name. 6. The YouTube Music app has a new macOS-shaped icon. 7. The FAQ now notes that passkeys and Touch ID sign-in are not available in macOS apps, so use a password and a two-factor code. ### 更新日志 1. macOS 隐藏标题栏时，ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini 和 DeepSeek 的标志和侧边栏按钮不再被左上角的红绿灯挡住，侧边栏展开和收起都一样。 2. 内置的网站样式微调只在对应的网站上生效，自己打包的应用不会再沾上为别的网站写的规则，比如页脚被隐藏或列表被压平。 3. macOS 上用中文或日文输入法按回车选词时，X、Grok 这类聊天框不会再把打了一半的内容发出去。 4. Windows 上的通知会播放系统提示音，只有网页要求静音时才不响。 5. Linux 的 deb 和 rpm 安装包只会装一个启动项，不再出现两个同名图标。 6. YouTube Music 应用换成了 macOS 样式的新图标。 7. FAQ 补充说明 macOS 应用用不了通行密钥和指纹登录，登录时改用密码加两步验证码。 Special thanks to @iamxtso for the report and to @houzixiashanxiedaima, @reg-chen, and @Totara-thib for the pull requests behind this release. If Pake helps you, please consider giving it a star and recommending it to your friends. > https://github.com/tw93/Pake

name: v1.14.3 - Linked specs, safer globs
body:
## What's New in v1.14.3

This release accepts spec files linked from elsewhere in your project, removes a dependency that kept failing security audits, and fixes a validate hang in pre-commit hooks.

### Improved

- **No more `braces` audit warning** - Installing OpenSpec no longer pulls in the unpatched `braces` package, so `npm audit` in your project stops reporting GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm through OpenSpec.
- **Glob artifacts stay inside the change** - The propose, ff, continue and explore workflows now choose and check a glob artifact's file path before anything writes it, including a skill or command the schema delegates creation to. A path that would leave the change directory, directly or through a symlink, is refused.

### Fixed

- **Linked spec files** - A capability's `spec.md` can be a symlink to a file elsewhere in the project, such as beside the product docs it belongs to. `list --specs`, `show`, `validate` and `archive` accept it; a link that resolves outside the project is still refused.
- **`validate --all` hanging in hooks** - On a terminal that reports zero columns, as some pre-commit runners provide, the spinner no longer loops forever writing cursor escapes. `OPEN_SPEC_INTERACTIVE=0` and `CI` now turn the spinner off too.
- **Very wide brace patterns** - A `generates` pattern whose braces expand to more than 1,024 paths is rejected with a clear error instead of running `openspec status` out of memory.

## New Contributors

* @CRYPTONIKAV made their first contribution in https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/pull/2104
* @surlymochan made their first contribution in https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/pull/2103

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Fission-AI/OpenSpec/compare/v1.14.2...v1.14.3

name: v18.11.3
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- `prepareQueuedMessages` receives which queue (`steering` or `followUp`) a batch came from ([#16026](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16026))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Fixed

- Fixed JSON Schema dereferencing rewriting literal values in `const`, `enum`, `default`, examples, and custom annotations, or treating property names as schema keywords ([#15927](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15927) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023)).
- Fixed Anthropic requests hanging forever on Bun 1.3 when the upstream accepted the request but never sent headers: aborting the request (including the first-event timeout) now fails it, so the turn retries instead of waiting until the user interrupts it ([#16010](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16010) by [@ca-io-systems](https://github.com/ca-io-systems))
- Fixed the auth gateway's `POST /v1/chat/completions` streams being dropped (`terminated`) after ~255 s without upstream output, e.g. while xAI generates a large tool call's arguments, which arrive only when complete; the stream now sends an SSE `: keepalive` comment every 15 s ([#15940](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15940) by [@radkawar](https://github.com/radkawar))
- Fixed Anthropic models with mid-conversation system messages (e.g. Claude Opus 5.5) receiving `@file` mention contents and hidden extension messages as a trailing `system` message instead of ending the request on the user's turn ([#15881](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15881))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Changed

- Renamed the built-in `google-antigravity` login option to "Google Antigravity (Gemini, Claude, GPT-OSS)" so it is distinguishable from similarly named third-party plugins and no longer implies support stops at Gemini 3 ([#15998](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15998) by [@savanne-kham](https://github.com/savanne-kham)).

### Fixed

- Fixed Command Code's `z-ai/glm-5.3-flash` failing every request with "not available on this endpoint": the catalog routes it to chat completions, the only endpoint Command Code lists for it ([#15922](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15922) by [@jasonharrison](https://github.com/jasonharrison))
- Fixed `/handoff` failing with `400 Provider returned error` on OpenRouter's hosted Muse Spark 1.x and Muse Wonder models: requests no longer send a `tool_choice` the upstream Meta backend rejects ([#15910](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15910))
- Fixed OpenCode Zen bringing back retired bundled models from an authoritative model cache, and dropping drop-listed models such as `gemini-3.7-flash` when a refresh fails after an upgrade ([#15770](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15770) by [@adi-IL](https://github.com/adi-IL))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Breaking Changes

- Extension `ui.approve()` hosts receive an optional `session` choice label and answer `"once"`, `"session"`, or `"deny"` instead of a boolean

### Added

- Added `imageCountBudget` to custom models and `modelOverrides` in models.yml, so a custom gateway can state its host's image limit instead of the default of 5; past that limit the oldest images were dropped on every new image, which rewrote the provider's prompt cache ([#15002](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15002), [#15969](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15969) by [@aramalipoor](https://github.com/aramalipoor))
- The status line names the active profile next to the `π` brand (`π-work`), so sessions from different profiles are distinguishable at a glance; the default profile is unchanged ([#15622](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15622) by [@matthewrball](https://github.com/matthewrball))
- Added opt-in `prewalk.auto` (`off`, `suggest`, or `on`): the native judge decides per task whether to arm a prewalk handoff to `prewalk.autoTarget`, and the next task starts back on the planning model ([#16026](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16026) by [@taibenvenuti](https://github.com/taibenvenuti))
- Added `/seance` and the task `seance` agent: consult a saved session read-only, in place, without resuming it or copying its artifacts; pick the source and an optional model from pickers, and send follow-ups to the consultant ([#15036](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15036) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))

### Changed

- Tool approval prompts list Approve, Approve `<tool>` for this session, and Deny again: with an empty composer, pick with the arrow keys and Enter; typing in the composer denies and steers instead, and the Deny row reads "Deny and send message" while you do

### Fixed

- Fixed the Isolate Subagents setting description implying that all tasks run isolated; each task must opt in with `isolated: true` ([#15987](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15987)).
- Fixed `read` labeling re-encoded images with the display format instead of the source file's format; it now identifies both when they differ ([#15890](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15890)).
- Fixed `omp -p` and `task` subagents reporting a clean finish with an earlier answer when a context overflow could not be compacted enough to retry; the overflow error is now the run's outcome ([#15897](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15897) by [@nhthung](https://github.com/nhthung))
- Fixed Cursor's Shell tool killing commands once its `block_until_ms` wait elapsed; the wait no longer sets the kill deadline, which comes from Cursor's `hard_timeout` or the bash default ([#15898](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15898) by [@nhthung](https://github.com/nhthung))
- Fixed an interrupted prompt's late setup cleanup marking the next prompt idle early, allowing overlapping submissions and releasing sleep prevention mid-turn ([#15946](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15946))
- Fixed hashline `REM` hiding the path-recovery warning when a nonexistent path matched an earlier-read file ([#15957](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15957)).
- Fixed tool downloads (`sd`, `sg`, `yt-dlp`, `trafilatura`) failing with `GitHub API error: 403` on a machine whose egress IP has spent GitHub's anonymous 60/hour budget; the release lookup now sends `GITHUB_TOKEN`/`GH_TOKEN` like omp's other GitHub API call sites ([#15981](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15981) by [@iacore](https://github.com/iacore))
- Background local memory extraction now stops after one bounded retry budget on repeated OpenAI-compatible 429 responses instead of multiplying transport, provider, and completion retries ([#15826](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15826)).
- Fixed a message-result subagent resumed by typing into its focused session leaving `agent://<id>` empty and never reporting its final reply to the parent ([#15948](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15948))
- Fixed `read` of an RSS or Atom feed showing `Untitled` for every item and dropping feed titles, descriptions, dates, and RSS item links ([#15954](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15954))
- Fixed `read` showing a binary notice instead of an HTML page when a server sends unlabeled gzip to the first request but decodable HTML to the second ([#15956](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15956))
- Fixed `read` returning a homepage's site-wide feed or a page's site-wide `llms.txt` alternate instead of the requested page ([#15955](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15955)).
- Fixed `ast_grep` reporting a clean "No matches found" for a pattern that does not parse in the target language (e.g. a bare C# identifier); it now lists the pattern's ERROR node as a parse issue ([#15950](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15950))
- Fixed `--resume <id>` and session listings skipping transcripts placed in the session directory as symlinks ([#15878](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15878), [#15884](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15884) by [@peda-cos](https://github.com/peda-cos))
- Fixed sessions with a deferred-connecting MCP server listing every routed MCP tool twice, once as a mount notice and once in route guidance ([#15982](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15982) by [@zcyoung2000](https://github.com/zcyoung2000))

### Removed

- Removed the built-in `rs-parking-lot` rule; Rust edits using `std::sync::{Mutex, RwLock}` with `.lock().unwrap()` are no longer steered to `parking_lot`

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Changed

- Changed `encodeSixel` and `encodeSixelAsync` to drop a partial last 6-pixel band, so an image never extends below the requested height and the caller no longer has to shrink it to a multiple of 6 ([#16007](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16007))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Added

- Added selection-only session and model picker actions for `/seance`, so choosing a source or model leaves the active session and model unchanged ([#15036](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15036) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))

### Changed

- `ApprovalDialogComponent` shows a choice list (Approve, an optional `session` row, Deny): the arrow keys move between them and Enter (armed after `APPROVE_ARM_MS`) takes the highlighted one; while a composer draft holds Enter the highlight sits on Deny, relabeled "Deny and send message"; Tern clicks on a choice take it; Page Up/Down scroll the details

### Fixed

- Fixed a streamed Markdown list keeping every item out of native scrollback until the turn ended, so rows that scrolled off screen were unreachable mid-stream; items in front of the newest one now retire as soon as it begins ([#13676](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/13676), [#15993](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15993) by [@shgew](https://github.com/shgew))
- Fixed SIXEL charts and SVG figures being resampled before display, which softened their text, on terminals whose cell height is not a multiple of 6 such as Windows Terminal ([#16007](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16007))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Fixed

- Fixed Markdown fence info-string parsing to keep backtick-containing backtick openers as paragraph text while accepting backticks in tilde info strings and Unicode line separators in either fence's info string ([#15928](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15928) by [@jchanghong023](https://github.com/jchanghong023)).
- Fixed `parseHTML` treating `<link>` in RSS/Atom documents as an HTML void element, which dropped the URL text of RSS `<link>…</link>` ([#15954](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15954))


## What's Changed
* fix(read): rendered rss and atom feed fields instead of untitled by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15959
* fix(tools): scoped read alternates to the requested page by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15960
* fix(read): rendered decoded html from binary refetch by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15961
* fix(edit): preserved recovery warnings on deleted files by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15962
* feat(coding-agent): configurable imageCountBudget for custom models by @aramalipoor in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15969
* fix(tools): send the environment token to the GitHub release lookup by @iacore in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15981
* fix(coding-agent): suppress mount notices duplicated by route guidance by @zcyoung2000 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15982
* fix(task): clarify opt-in subagent isolation setting by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15990
* fix(tui): retire finished items of a streaming list mid-stream by @shgew in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15993
* fix(catalog): rename Google Antigravity login label by @savanne-kham in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15998
* fix(tui): encoded sixel images at their cell box without resampling by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16009
* fix(ai): failed an aborted cowork request that never received headers by @ca-io-systems in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16010
* feat(tui): tag the status-line brand with the active profile by @matthewrball in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15622
* fix(catalog): preserve authoritative caches in resolveProviderModels by @adi-IL in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15770
* fix(memory): bounded background extraction retries by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15827
* fix(ai): kept user-attributed developer turns off anthropic system role by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15883
* fix(session): follow symlinks in session inventory scans by @peda-cos in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15884
* fix(read): corrected source image format labels by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15892
* fix(coding-agent): kept an unrecovered context overflow as the run's outcome by @nhthung in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15897
* fix(cursor): stopped killing Shell commands at the block_until_ms wait by @nhthung in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15898
* fix(catalog): route Command Code z-ai/glm-5.3-flash to chat completions by @jasonharrison in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15922
* fix(ai): preserve literal data while dereferencing schemas by @jchanghong023 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15927
* fix(utils): preserve invalid backtick fences as prose by @jchanghong023 in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15928
* fix(ai): keep auth-gateway chat-completions SSE streams alive during upstream silence by @radkawar in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15940
* fix(session): preserved next prompt state after interrupted setup by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15947
* fix(task): publish user-resumed message results to agent:// and parent by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15949
* fix(natives): reported ast-grep patterns that parse to an ERROR node by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15958
* fix(catalog): omitted tool_choice for openrouter muse models by @roboomp in https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15911

name: v18.11.2
body:
## @oh-my-pi/pi-agent-core

### Added

- `agent_start` carries `resumedToolCallIds` when a continued run first executes the calls of an unpaired assistant tail

### Fixed

- Cancelling an `ask` after a background job finishes now reports the user cancellation instead of telling the model to retry a skipped tool ([#15985](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15985))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-ai

### Breaking Changes

- `resolveGatewayApiKey` and `buildGatewayApiKeyResolver` (`@oh-my-pi/pi-ai/auth-gateway`) take the request's route options (`{ storage, client? }`) instead of an `AuthStorage`, their resolver callback receives the resolved credential, and `resolveGatewayAccount` takes that credential ([#15900](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15900) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))

### Added

- Added scoped clients to `startAuthGateway` (`clients`, `setClients`): each client bearer is limited to its own models and OAuth accounts, with no fallback to other accounts or API keys, and request log lines name the client and the credential a request started on ([#5098](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/5098), [#15900](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15900) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))
- Added experimental native image judgments for TypeSafe Jev's `jev-latest`, `jev-preview`, `jev-1.13.0`, and `jev-1.14.0`, plus OpenRouter's `typesafe/jev-1.13`, `typesafe/jev-1.14`, and `~typesafe/jev-latest` models; images outside Jev's documented size bounds fall through to a vision chat judge instead of failing ([#15887](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15887) by [@anatoli-tsinovoy](https://github.com/anatoli-tsinovoy))

### Fixed

- Fixed error results from non-first-party providers regaining partial output the provider had discarded; an error with empty content now stays empty ([#14516](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14516), [#14572](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14572) by [@oleg494](https://github.com/oleg494))
- Fixed the auth gateway's `POST /v1/audio/speech` answering 502 for requests the speech adapter rejects (unsupported format, over-long input); they now get 400 `invalid_request_error` ([#14508](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14508) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed a single-string tool call with two or more mislabelled string fields silently dispatching whichever field came first in the JSON; such ambiguous calls now fail validation and the model sees its own arguments back ([#14414](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14414) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed GLM-5.2 on Ollama Cloud losing its reasoning between turns; Ollama Cloud now keeps assistant thinking in history for models verified to accept it ([#14440](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14440) by [@Dante-dan](https://github.com/Dante-dan))
- Fixed GPT Image generation and edits failing on gateways that validate request parameters, such as LiteLLM; `response_format` is no longer sent to GPT Image models ([#14619](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14619) by [@jimhester](https://github.com/jimhester))
- Fixed OpenRouter errors such as "Access denied by security policy" dropping the routed upstream's own explanation from `error.metadata.raw` ([#10906](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/10906), [#14435](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14435) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed GitHub Copilot usage reporting an AI-credit allowance as "Premium Requests" in request units; the unit each billing item reports is now honoured ([#13849](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/13849), [#14501](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14501) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed an OpenAI-compatible server's `finish_reason: "repetition"` or `stop_reason: "repetition_detected"` not being treated as a thinking loop, so the degenerate partial reasoning was kept and replayed into the next turn ([#12525](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12525), [#14535](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14535) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-catalog

### Added

- Added `keep-bundled-names` catalog attribute to preserve static model display names during discovery
- Updated `openai-codex` provider configuration to prevent model name regressions during live discovery

### Changed

- GPT Image models (`gpt-image-*`, `chatgpt-image-*`) now classify as their own `gpt-image` family instead of `gpt` or `chatgpt`, so GPT chat-model rules no longer apply to them ([#14619](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14619) by [@jimhester](https://github.com/jimhester))

### Fixed

- Fixed OpenCode Zen Gemini 4 Argon failing with an unsupported protocol; it now uses the native Gemini endpoint ([#15977](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15977)).

## @oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent

### Added

- Added `lsp.requestTimeout` setting to configure wait durations for language server diagnostics and requests
- Added `omp auth-gateway serve --clients=<file>`: per-client bearer tokens, each limited to listed models and broker OAuth accounts with no fallback to other accounts or API keys, re-read while serving ([#5098](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/5098), [#15900](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15900) by [@alphastorm](https://github.com/alphastorm))

### Changed

- The `lsp` tool now uses `lsp.requestTimeout` to dynamically adjust both call deadlines and project-aware diagnostic wait times, with support for per-call overrides
- Reduced CPU overhead during syntax checks and automatic edit repairs ([#15904](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15904) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).
- Reduced status-line refresh overhead while subagents have long conversations ([#15874](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15874) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).
- Agents now send `todo` updates alongside their next tool call instead of spending a separate model turn on them ([#15402](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15402) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- The Shared Language Servers setting now says what it does: each connection gets its own server, and a released one is reused while another omp instance keeps the project's mux running ([#14633](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14633) by [@jorgoose](https://github.com/jorgoose))
- Memories saved explicitly through the extension `memory.save` API are now stored as `stated` rather than `unknown`, so they rank as deliberate memories in Mnemopi recall ([#13824](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13824) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))

### Fixed

- Fixed prewalk switching models during read-only MCP lookups through `write xd://` when the server marks the tool read-only ([#15994](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15994))
- Fixed Ctrl+C printing `9;5u` in the shell after force-quitting omp with a third Ctrl+C while it was still closing the session
- Fixed Smart unexpected-stop recovery continuing finished answers, which added extra "nothing more to add" turns
- Fixed `grep` searching only the first 4 MB of a file named directly, so later matches were reported as absent; the whole file is now searched, and a multiline pattern, which still reads only the first 4 MB, says so in its no-match headline ([#15942](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/15942))
- Fixed browser `uploadFile` failing with "Not allowed" through the relay or into a Chrome on another machine, stalling behind macOS folder-privacy prompts, and breaking the tab on large drop-zone files ([#15489](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15489) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed browser `uploadFile` sending a stale copy of a file rewritten without changing its size or timestamp, failing on folders that contain a symlink loop, and deleting copies a still-open attached page could read after a repeat upload
- Fixed plan mode (including plan-yolo) looping on `write xd://propose` forever when an extension provides a tool named `write`; the extension tool is left out of plan mode with a warning, since only the built-in `write` can submit plans ([#14030](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14030), [#14438](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14438) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed legacy Mnemopi bank databases staying open after the recall bank probe, which could block deleting them on Windows ([#14584](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14584) by [@yshihao636](https://github.com/yshihao636))
- Fixed startup skipping a configured default fallback whose provider authenticates only through another provider's key (e.g. `xai-oauth` via `XAI_API_KEY`) and picking an unrelated model instead ([#15781](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15781))
- Fixed slower startup when the configured default model is unavailable and no fallback chain is configured ([#15781](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15781))
- Fixed `read` directory listings printing a directory's raw listing error, whose tabs, newlines, or control characters could break the transcript; `[unreadable: …]` is now a single bounded line ([#15789](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15789))
- Fixed a `^` model mention sent while the agent is working (steer, follow-up, or queued skill prompt) never announcing its new `m<N>` alias to the model ([#14093](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14093), [#14322](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14322) by [@holny](https://github.com/holny))
- Fixed large session files ending in a truncated record not being repaired on load, unlike small ones ([#14582](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14582) by [@yshihao636](https://github.com/yshihao636))
- Fixed a read-only subagent's rejected `write` reading as a dead end: when `yield` is available, the rejection now names it as the way to return the content ([#14308](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14308), [#14470](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14470) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed `/retry` after an interrupt leaving later advisor notes and extension asides unable to wake the agent until the next typed prompt ([#14831](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14831) by [@daandden](https://github.com/daandden))
- Fixed session titles and idle recaps disappearing after a corrupt `history.db` was quarantined and recreated, and a briefly busy store disabling the session index for the rest of the session ([#13929](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/13929), [#14361](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14361) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed pasting a screenshot with ⌘V into omp running over SSH from Tern or kitty failing with `Clipboard is empty` or `Image not found` ([#15369](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15369) by [@LoneExile](https://github.com/LoneExile))
- Fixed native hook discovery silently ignoring hooks symlinked into `hooks/pre` or `hooks/post` ([#14189](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14189), [#14536](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14536) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed headless Linux containers without a system D-Bus logging a `Failed to acquire power assertion` warning on every turn; the missing backend is now noted once at debug level ([#14591](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14591) by [@tahakotil](https://github.com/tahakotil))
- Fixed a project's daemon broker staying unreachable after its runtime directory was deleted while it ran (`proc://`, `wait`, shared LSP and the shared browser failed with `connect ENOENT …/broker.sock`); the broker now releases the project within seconds of losing its socket and the next request starts a fresh one ([#14466](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14466) by [@nick-maderight](https://github.com/nick-maderight))
- Fixed SQL and Redis sessions stalling after a rewrite raced an append; later turns now republish after the backend recovers ([#15612](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15612) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed OpenAI Codex web search failing with "No Codex OAuth credentials found" when only `OPENAI_CODEX_OAUTH_TOKEN` is set ([#12537](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12537), [#14337](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14337) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed `yield` rejecting a valid `data` result when a non-strict provider also filled `error` with a placeholder such as `unused` or `n/a`; a real error alongside `data` is still rejected, now with exact resend instructions ([#15633](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15633) by [@Komzpa](https://github.com/Komzpa))
- Fixed secret redaction replaying Gemini tool calls with their original `thoughtSignature` after rewriting the call arguments; a rewritten call now drops the signature, as rewritten thinking already did ([#14392](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14392) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed Claude marketplace plugin MCP servers declaring a sub-second `timeout` (e.g. SAP's `"timeout": 600`) never loading; values below Claude Code's 1000 ms minimum are now ignored with a warning so the default timeout applies ([#12485](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12485), [#14574](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14574) by [@oleg494](https://github.com/oleg494))
- Fixed automatic retries looping without end when the primary model's cooldown expired mid-retry: the session no longer switches back to the primary while a retry is still in flight, and returns to it on the next prompt ([#14611](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14611) by [@MiloMMIN](https://github.com/MiloMMIN))
- Fixed web search providers garbling non-UTF-8 responses; they now decode with the charset declared in `Content-Type` (or a `<meta charset>` tag), the same way fetched pages are ([#15304](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15304) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))
- Fixed `openai-models-list` discovery ignoring a flat `max_tokens` output limit on `/v1/models` rows, which pinned such models to the 32K default ([#13062](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/13062), [#14403](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14403) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed long replies dropping lines from scrollback or replaying them duplicated and out of order when status widgets stay taller after a turn or transient HUDs close ([#15820](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15820) by [@emmahyde](https://github.com/emmahyde))
- Fixed a stale "Working…" row staying under a focused subagent after it finished while the main session kept running ([#15820](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15820))
- Fixed `omp update` failing when a bunfig `minimumReleaseAge` or npmrc `min-release-age` supply-chain cooldown rejects the just-published release; self-update now overrides the cooldown for the pinned version it installs ([#14581](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14581) by [@morri-son](https://github.com/morri-son))
- Fixed `agent://<id>` returning a message-result subagent's first result after it completed a parent-requested follow-up; reads now return its latest completed result ([#15707](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15707) by [@mg-mg-mg](https://github.com/mg-mg-mg))
- Fixed sloppy edits silently dropping an operator when one `*** Find` was followed by two (e.g. `*** Insert Before` and `*** Replace`); the payload is now rejected with an error naming both and nothing is applied ([#14357](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14357) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed a cancelled Python tool install (e.g. `uv tool install`) falling through to `pip` with the aborted signal and leaving the install progress running ([#15750](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15750) by [@harshaygadekar](https://github.com/harshaygadekar))
- Fixed auto-learn captures rewriting earlier OpenAI Responses history after a learning tool call, which broke prompt-cache reuse ([#14099](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14099) by [@nanbloom001](https://github.com/nanbloom001))
- Fixed `/shake images` leaving the context percentage unchanged; the tokens freed by the removed images are now reported and subtracted from the context meter right away ([#5029](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/5029), [#14367](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14367) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed `/fork pane|tab` and Herdr `ctx.ui.openTerminal()` launches failing in panes whose shell is not POSIX (such as Nushell); Herdr launches now type only the path of a self-deleting `/bin/sh` script and no longer ask for POSIX-shell confirmation ([#15262](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15262) by [@shgew](https://github.com/shgew))
- Fixed Eval `read("artifact://N")` returning an "Unbounded raw read blocked" notice instead of the text for artifacts over 50 KB that belong to another session, or when the session has no artifacts directory, in JavaScript and Python cells ([#15410](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15410) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed cancelling a bash job hard-killing it before its TERM cleanup handlers could run; it now gets up to one second to clean up before termination is forced ([#15709](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15709) by [@mg-mg-mg](https://github.com/mg-mg-mg))
- Fixed the transcript collapsing to one line per entry after switching between a subagent and the main session mid-turn when an earlier turn left a tool call without a result ([#12247](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12247), [#15466](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15466) by [@shgew](https://github.com/shgew))
- Fixed a retried tool losing its transcript card when the view was rebuilt (subagent focus switch, overlay close) while the tool was still running
- Fixed Chrome element handles' `uploadFile()` failing "Node is not a file input element" on labels, chooser triggers and drop zones; it now uploads like `tab.uploadFile()` ([#15918](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15918) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Browser `tab.fill` in Chrome sets colour, date, time and range inputs to the given value (it typed `2026-10-12` as `61012-02-02` and left a colour at `#000000`), and refuses a value the input rejects ([#15914](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15914) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed browser `uploadFile` on a control that opens `showOpenFilePicker()` hanging the cell until the tab was killed; it now fails at once with a named error ([#15915](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15915) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed every later file chooser on a page doing nothing, the user's own clicks in a relay tab included, after browser `uploadFile` clicked a chooser trigger or drop zone ([#15915](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15915) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed browser `uploadFile` in Chrome reporting success with no file attached when the element opens no file chooser and nothing on the page reads the dropped files; it now fails and says what to target ([#15919](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15919) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Relay mode: when Chrome detaches omp from a tab it drives (a password manager's inline menu loading in the page), the call fails at once saying why and omp reattaches to the same tab, instead of every later call timing out and reopening failing with `No page targets available` ([#15920](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15920) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the macOS `computer` tool letting the display sleep and lock in a turn that went 5 minutes without a desktop action; it now keeps the display awake until the turn ends or asks for your answer, then lets it sleep ([#15762](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15762) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-mnemopi

### Fixed

- Fixed `MNEMOPI_<LABEL>_WEIGHT` and `MNEMOPI_TIER<N>_WEIGHT` having no effect on recall ranking ([#13824](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/13824) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-natives

### Added

- Added `parseCodeStatus` to check code syntax and its resolved language without generating a summary ([#15904](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15904) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal)).
- Added `DesktopSession.holdDisplayUntilReleased()` and `releaseDisplayAwake()` to keep the display awake until the caller releases it, rather than for 5 minutes after the last request ([#15762](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15762) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Changed

- Reduced idle memory on GNU/Linux: once native work has been quiet for 5 seconds, freed native heap pages are returned to the OS without evicting caches ([#15905](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15905) by [@iliaal](https://github.com/iliaal))
- Reduced memory held by cached code-structure parses: the cache now caps estimated syntax-tree memory instead of source size, keeps only a file's current and previous parse, and reparses edited files incrementally ([#15886](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15886) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Changed `warmBlockParse` to skip files over 2 MiB (was 4 MiB), the size above which a typical parse no longer fits the cache ([#15886](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15886) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))

### Fixed

- Fixed `listWorkspace({ reportDirectoryErrors: true, maxDepth: 0 })` returning an empty result for an unreadable root instead of failing the scan ([#15789](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15789))
- Minimized cargo output now keeps one "Blocking waiting for file lock on …" line, so a build stuck behind another cargo process says why ([#14631](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14631) by [@jorgoose](https://github.com/jorgoose))
- Fixed `grep` ignoring `maxCountPerFile` when the path is a single file, and single-file count mode stopping at the `maxCount` content cap ([#14162](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14162), [#14327](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14327) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Changed

- Improved nested tool status line rendering: moved preview content into a dedicated collapsible code block when expanded and limited field widths on the one-line summary
- Suppressed typo highlighting for the word currently being typed to avoid distracting inline markers while composing

### Fixed

- Fixed double-clicking an extension switched off in `/extensions` in Tern not switching it back on
- Fixed the queued-messages badge in Tern showing a bare count that read as the first message's number; it now reads `N queued`
- Fixed table charts on TSP terminals to use SVG fences and respect terminal palette
- Fixed table charts in Tern's native view drawing in the other appearance's colors (light labels on a light page) when omp's light/dark detection disagreed with Tern; Tern now colors them in the theme it shows, like the prose around them
- Fixed the /btw history answer being stuck at the bottom while a follow-up is being written: Up/Down and Page Up/Down now scroll the answer without leaving the draft ([#15902](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15902) by [@H4vC](https://github.com/H4vC))
- Fixed macOS editor spelling assistance hanging silently when the spelling service stops responding; it now reports and disables itself instead ([#12084](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12084), [#14341](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14341) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed a chip toggled in a multi-select setting's open submenu leaving its row and its tab's changed badge showing the old selection until the submenu was closed ([#14444](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14444) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed `@` file autocomplete freezing when the project contains a symlink into a very large directory tree; the fuzzy walk now stops after 1.5 s and the popup falls back to the immediate-directory listing ([#12317](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/12317), [#14330](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14330) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed omp in a Tern pane showing the classic CLI when a shell rc, dev shell or `.env` set `TERM` to a `screen*`/`tmux*` value with no multiplexer running; only a real tmux/screen/zellij/herdr/cmux/wmux session now keeps Tern's native view off
- omp inside devenv 2.x's reloading `devenv shell` now starts on the classic renderer instead of opening Tern's native view and abandoning it: devenv's terminal layer drops Tern's protocol, so the native view needs `devenv shell --no-reload`. The debug log now records why a Tern pane stays on the classic renderer
- Fixed large terminal paints on Windows being split mid-row, which let other output land inside a row; writes are now cut at row boundaries ([#14187](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14187) by [@mateusant13](https://github.com/mateusant13))
- Fixed `TUI.addStartListener()` hooks added after `start()` never running until the next stop/start cycle; a hook added to a running TUI now runs at once ([#15369](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15369) by [@LoneExile](https://github.com/LoneExile))
- Fixed the git viewer advertising stage, discard, select and commit keys while showing a clean tree's HEAD commit, where none of them do anything; the footer and sidebar now describe the commit view ([#14347](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/14347), [#14480](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14480) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed the status line `pr` segment keeping the previous branch's PR after switching to the default branch, a detached HEAD, or a branch without a PR ([#15455](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15455) by [@ravshansbox](https://github.com/ravshansbox))
- Fixed the status-line footer total leaving out task subagent spend; it now reads the session's cumulative usage, the same source the interactive status line uses ([#14393](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14393) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Fixed transcript rows disappearing from scrollback or reappearing out of order when bottom chrome stays taller after a turn, self-clearing HUDs close, or the composer shape changes ([#15820](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15820) by [@emmahyde](https://github.com/emmahyde))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-utils

### Added

- Exported `sqliteFileIdentity()`, so a caller holding a long-lived SQLite connection can tell when its path now names a different file (e.g. after a corrupt store was quarantined and replaced) ([#14361](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14361) by [@F0Rextasy](https://github.com/F0Rextasy))
- Added `slugify()`, the shared lowercase ASCII kebab-case helper with an optional `maxLength` ([#14283](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/14283) by [@jaredlyon](https://github.com/jaredlyon))

### Fixed

- Fixed an unhandled rejection when a subprocess is spawned with an already-aborted signal ([#15750](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/15750) by [@harshaygadekar](https://github.com/harshaygadekar))

name: Reasonix Studio v2.43.0
body:
本版新增会话间消息（实验）、跨项目的对话正文搜索、模型读视频、更新方式“自动下载”和可选起始分支的独立工作目录，并修复多个会话同时开着时的界面卡死、停止无效，以及一批界面和英文界面问题。

## 新增

- 设置里新增“会话间消息（实验）”：可查看本机别的会话、给它们发文字；收到的文字在输入框上方等你批准，批准后才交给模型。默认关闭。关联 #11376。
- 开启“会话间消息”后，模型多了 list_peers 和 send_peer_message 两个工具；发送前先问你（卡片显示收件会话和全文），对方的用户批准后才交给它的模型。关联 #11376。
- 侧栏搜索除了按名称筛选，停顿后还会搜所有项目里对话的正文，列出命中的对话和片段，点一下就打开。关联 #11942。
- 在 Windows 缩放 100% 的宽屏（2400 像素以上）上，首次使用会问一次“界面是不是偏小”，可一键放大并可恢复，不会擅自改动。关联 #11962。
- 模型来源列表的小圆点会记住上一次测试：失败是红点、悬停可见原因，通过是空心圈，换了地址或密钥就清掉。关联 #12040。
- 工具调用跑了 10 秒还没结束时，卡片上出现“只停止这一条调用”，点了只结束这一条，本轮继续，模型会被告知该调用是被你停止的。关联 #12254。
- 对话里的图片也能从你授权给当前工作区的文件夹（设置 → 沙盒 → 额外文件夹）里显示，文件夹之外的本地图片仍显示为占位框。关联 #13125。
- 新会话的分支入口升级为“配置工作目录”：可选起始分支，首次发送时创建独立的 worktree；已有对话仍可切换分支。关联 #13264 fixed in #13273 by @SivanCola。

- 任务运行时，输入框上方的状态条会写出本轮已运行多久（如“read_file · 1m 6s”），不用回到对话区看计时。关联 #13346、#13253。

Adds messages between sessions (experimental), cross-project text search, video reading, auto-download updates and worktrees from a chosen branch; fixes the many-sessions freeze and UI bugs.

## New

- Settings gain Messages between sessions (experimental): list other local sessions, send them text, and approve what arrives in a bar above the composer. Off by default. Refs #11376.
- With messages between sessions on, the model gains list_peers and send_peer_message; sending asks you first and shows the recipient and full text, and the other user must approve. Refs #11376.
- The sidebar search now also looks through the text of conversations in every project once you pause, listing the matching conversations with a passage; click one to open it. Refs #11942.
- On a wide display (2400 px or more) at 100% scaling, Studio asks once whether the interface is too small and offers 125% or 150% with a restore; it never resizes by itself. Refs #11962.
- The dot on each model source remembers its last test: red for a failed one with the cause on hover, a hollow ring for a pass, cleared when the address or key changes. Refs #12040.
- A tool call still running after 10 seconds offers "Stop only this call": it ends that call, the turn goes on, and the model is told you stopped it. Refs #12254.
- Pictures in a conversation also load from a folder you granted this workspace (Settings, Sandbox, extra folders); local pictures elsewhere still show a placeholder. Refs #13125.
- The new-session branch control becomes "Configure working directory": pick a base branch and a separate worktree is created on first send; existing conversations keep branch switching. Refs #13264 fixed in #13273 by @SivanCola.
- Settings > Version > Update mode gains Download (off by default): it downloads and verifies a release in the background and offers a restart when idle, never restarting alone. Refs #13291.
- While a turn runs, the chip above the composer says how long it has been running (e.g. "read_file · 1m 6s"), so you need not check the transcript. Refs #13346, #13253.
- Screenshots attached in the feedback window can be clicked to view at full size, in both the new-report and reply forms; Esc closes the viewer and the screenshot stays attached. Refs #13350.
- A first sidebar read that takes over 15 seconds says it is still reading and offers Retry, which starts a fresh request instead of queueing behind the stuck one. Refs #13345.
- The composer's plan fold shows the /goal text when there is no plan, and the Conversation, Run analysis and Workbench views get shortcuts (Ctrl/Cmd 1, 2, 3) and command-palette entries. Refs #13369.
- Settings gain a "Several sessions writing one project" switch (optimistic mode, off by default); it applies to sessions opened afterwards. Refs #13384, #13392.
- `tools.mcp_resources = true` in your user config lets the model read a resource a connected MCP server lists, asking you first each time (off by default). Refs #13385.
- The MCP resource tool also reads addresses a server's declared resource templates (like `doc://item/{id}`) can build; any other address is still refused. Refs #13385.
- My feedback gets a sticky filter bar (All, New replies, Needs your reply, Open, Closed, with counts) so reports with news are easy to find in a long list. Fixes #13388 fixed in #13404.
- Tool-call cards get a "show this result again at the end" button that repeats the call's own output at the end of the conversation, so you need not hunt for it. Refs #13394.
- The model can look at a video: read_video samples frames with the local ffmpeg and hands them over as images (no audio or motion); needs an image-reading model and says so without ffmpeg. Refs #13399.
- The command-line release archives now carry the web page, so reasonix serve opens in a browser straight after unpacking. Fixes #13406 fixed in #13423.
- The card asking before a command reaches a site outside `allowed_domains` offers "always allow", adding the site to your own list so it is not asked again. Refs #13478.
- New user-config `agent.goal_auto_retry` (default 0): a Goal paused because its completion check could not run is retried with backoff, up to that many times. Refs #13478.
- Settings → Tools gains a "Plan approval" switch (also `agent.plan_approval = "auto"` in user config): when on, a submitted plan starts without waiting for your click; off by default. Refs #13478.
- Clicking a running task under Background tasks shows its output (refreshed every 2 seconds, copyable, stoppable) without affecting the model's own reader. Refs #4783.
- When the open-session limit you set makes the window fold a session out of the tab bar, a note names it and says it is still in the list. Refs #13419.
- New user-config `sandbox.egress_unlisted = "allow"`: hosts outside allowed_domains pass without asking, said once per host; denied_domains still refuse; off by default. Refs #13478.
- The background task list now shows the name the model gave a task (bash takes an optional description); hover, focus or long press shows the full name and command, selectable. Refs #13458.

## Changed

- Adding a model source asks for protocol, address and API key first; the source name moves last and is made after connecting, so you no longer have to invent one up front. Refs #12040.
- The web search, thinking and continuation switches on a model service join the connection form's draft: they apply on Save and Revert undoes them. Refs #12040.
- While a Git branch switch runs, the branch button in the composer says "Switching to xxx…" instead of only fading. Refs #12780.
- Removed the extra magnifier from the sidebar's All / Live / Pinned / Archived row; search sessions from the top bar. Refs #13023.
- When a saved compaction stops matching its history mid-session and the full history is sent instead, a notice says why instead of widening silently. Refs #13148, #13295.
- When a settings save is refused because the config file does not parse, the message names the file. Refs #13220.
- A separate worktree uses only committed code and carries draft attachments, keeping the draft on failure; the five composer menus share typography, spacing, corners and selected state. Refs #13264 fixed in #13273 by @SivanCola.
- Empty toolbars in narrow chat panes stay compact on focus and expand for text, attachments or open menus, so buttons stay under the pointer during a click. Refs #13264 fixed in #13273 by @SivanCola.
- After a change the host could not read, the end-of-turn prompt no longer says making it again settles it: only conclude_blocked or you can, and it explains once. Refs #13293.
- With thousands of sessions in one folder, the first read after a restart no longer opens every session file; only changed ones are re-read, and refreshing after a rename is much faster. Refs #13345.
- A failed automatic naming says why (title model timed out, returned no text, or its endpoint refused with a status and its words), not only "try again". Refs #13353.
- The Conversation / Run analysis / Workbench row is gone: Run analysis and Workbench are icons on the window bar (press again to return) and the plan is in the composer. Refs #13369.
- The side-question entry moves from the top view strip to the composer toolbar (a chat icon after attach), with a tooltip and a pressed state while the panel is open. Refs #13369.
- The task and fleet tool descriptions say that under write_lease = optimistic a writer without write_paths holds only the path it is writing, not the whole workspace. Refs #13395 fixed in #13397.
- When the kernel exits with a failure code, the crash folder keeps a file naming the code and the reason, instead of an empty file that is dropped or removed. Refs #13433.
- The vertical rail under each card's icon and the left rule of the Execution group are gone, so one tool call looks the same wherever it appears. Refs #13456.
- A result brought to the end is the same single row as in the Execution group (no box, icon square or track); dark-theme rows there lose their slab background. Refs #13456.
- With several session tabs open, switching tabs and filtering the sidebar is faster: a switch no longer redraws every hidden session. Refs #13326.
- The approval card says where "Allow for this session" and "Always allow" are kept: the first only for the session, the second as a user-config permission rule Settings can undo. Refs e54381d4f.
- Side conversations are no longer capped at 3 open at once; set `agent.max_side_sessions` in your user config to limit them. Refs #13526.
- Hardening: a hand-written message body in the inbox folder is reduced on read like a sent one (controls and bidi overrides), so it cannot fake a terminal or the approval prompt. Refs #11376.
- Hardening: names in messages between sessions are reduced on read, so a forged record cannot put line breaks, escapes or markup before the model or a terminal. Refs #11376.
- With the ask timeout on, a task list handed back to you continues after that time, assumptions stated, at most 3 times in a row; off by default. Refs #13478.
- Improved: local panes share one event stream, so any number of open panes holds 2 connections and Stop never starves. Refs #13533.
- Approval, ask, remember, guardian, extension and similar cards now share one shell: the same radius, border and ground, a header with no fill, and no state-tinted border. Refs #13456.
- A low-risk allowed guardian review and a remembered fact are now a single row (the Forget button stays in it); refusals and medium-or-higher-risk reviews keep their cards. Refs #13456.
- An opened step's detail is now a panel with a hairline on all four sides, instead of a rule down its left edge. Refs #13456.
- The sidebar's top-left mark is one row: the wordmark with a compact filled STUDIO badge beside it, vertically centred and in the same place in both themes. Refs #13456.
- Host notices in the conversation (model switches, warnings, failures) are now a single bar: no box, header strip or wash, and the glyph's colour alone shows severity. Refs #13456.

## Fixed

- When editing a model source, "read available models" tests the address, key and protocol on the form that are not saved yet, instead of only the saved ones. Refs #12040.
- Choosing /review or /security-review and pressing Enter with no task reviews the pending changes by their default scope instead of being refused. Refs #12883.
- Failed tool results kept by a compaction no longer pile up across rounds: they get their own budget (5% of the window), older ones fold into the digest. Refs #13148.
- A session tab's dot no longer sometimes keeps breathing after a turn has ended. Refs #13254.
- More read-only git commands (merge-base and the listing forms of branch, remote, config and stash) no longer count as an unproven change or raise the verification prompt. Refs #13293.
- Read-only gh commands (list and view of pr, issue, run, release and repo, pr checks, gh api reads) no longer raise the verification prompt. Refs #13293.
- A reply's copy, quote and more buttons no longer appear while the tools under that reply are still running, so the turn no longer looks finished. Refs #13343.
- Local pictures written in a reply: pictures inside the workspace now show, and pictures outside it no longer draw as broken images but as a placeholder that says why. Refs #13354.
- After picking a skill or command with / and typing on, "Loading commands and skills…" no longer keeps appearing; it shows only while the caret is in a slash word. Refs #13358 fixed in #13361.
- Tall pictures (such as phone screenshots) sent with a message no longer spill out of their thumbnail over the text: each is held to the thumbnail size. Refs #13368.
- Opening a session from the Archived view no longer adds an empty "New session" row to the everyday list. Fixes #13377 fixed in #13386.
- When the kernel does not answer in time while you answer a question card, its error now has padding and a clear colour instead of hugging the card's edge. Refs #13379.
- A conversation open in a pane keeps its own titled row when the list's scope, search or page size leaves it out, so its tab shows the real title. Fixes #13402 fixed in #13407.
- After recovering sessions from an older Reasonix, the project folders they came from appear in the sidebar, so recovered sessions are no longer imported but invisible. Fixes #13412 fixed in #13413.
- On Linux, when the folder panel cannot be shown, Add folder and Recover older sessions ask for the path instead of doing nothing. Fixes #13421 fixed in #13424.
- Sessions recovered from an older Reasonix keep the title 1.x showed; earlier copies get it on the next Recover older sessions, instead of showing as v4-file names. Refs #13439.
- In the English UI, 15 notices such as "this project's hooks need your approval" no longer show in Chinese, and a check now stops a new notice from shipping without English. Fixes #13441 fixed in #13447.
- The small arrow on the composer's execution-permission picker was smaller and sat lower than the other pickers' arrows; it now matches them. Fixes #13472 fixed in #13509.
- With Chinese selected, the sub-menu descriptions of `/goal`, `/memory`, `/mcp`, `/theme`, `/feedback` and similar commands are no longer English. Fixes #13493 fixed in #13505.
- Keyboard: Settings, the command palette and other dialogs keep Tab inside and return focus on close; the remote-session delete button shows a focus ring in the light theme. Refs d191b73fc.
- On phone-width windows the "Models" heading in the connection settings no longer breaks into two lines; the buttons beside it wrap onto the next line. Refs #12040.
- Settings → Network → "Test it" words every step in the interface language: the English window no longer shows Chinese step names, advice or sentences such as "key was rejected". Refs #12040.
- Fixed: with thousands of sessions the sidebar refresh was slow; on Windows each refresh drops from about 0.9 s to about 0.1 s. Refs #13176.
- Fixed: Settings › Storage no longer counts the sessions and archive in the "Configuration and credentials" row when they share a folder, as on a default Windows install. Refs #13345.
- Fixed: on the permission picker in the Full access state, the arrow and warning icon now share the label's colour (the arrow was grey; the icon lighter in the light theme). Refs #13472 fixed in #13509.
- Fixed: a fresh session no longer shows a "This turn ¥0.00" placeholder in a currency nothing has priced; the figure appears with the first priced round. Refs #13513.
- Fixed: an MCP server connected by hand now leaves its handshake in the cache like a started one, so the next session needs no handshake; a quick close used to lose it. Refs #13485.
- With five or six session tabs open, Stop and Send no longer stall on the connection limit: hidden idle tabs release their live connection and resume from their cursor. Refs #13491.
- Fixed: the first sidebar load after start was slow with thousands of sessions; on Windows about 2,000 sessions drop from about 10 s to about 1 s. Refs #13176.
- Fixed: after the model hands the list back with await_user, the host no longer starts new rounds for gaps like an unverified change; the turn waits for you. Refs #13467.

## Upgrade notes

- Settings > Appearance gains "Session tabs kept open", default 0: every open session is kept (it used to quietly fold one past 4); set N to fold the longest-idle one. Refs #13419.

# oh-my-codex v0.21.17
