name: v6.7.2
body:
Patch release: fixes from an audit of the issue history. Most of them stop a tool from losing, overwriting or rewriting content while it reports success.

## Installation and startup

- **Skill-only installations create projects in your working folder again** (703aa72f, #144). Since v6.3.0, `project_manager.py init` placed projects relative to the installed skill. For an `npx skills` or plugin installation, that meant `.agents/projects/` or the plugin cache, where an update can replace them. Inside a repository checkout nothing changes.
- On Windows, a `python3` that never starts (the WindowsApps stub exits 9009 with no output) is no longer treated as an integrity-guard failure; the agent retries with `python` first (e1b58732, follow-up on #142).

## Source conversion and import

- **PDF**: removed four table rewrites that were written against one sample paper. They re-derived variable categories from hard-coded symbols, replaced headers, dropped rows and invented a correlation column. Extracted cells are now kept as extracted (3aa2ec62).
- **HTML**: pages are decoded by BOM and their charset declaration instead of forced UTF-8, so a `<meta charset="gbk">` page no longer comes out as replacement characters. A guessed encoding is reported (34d88c1a).
- **Web**: pages with the same title in one batch get `Report.md`, `Report_2.md` instead of overwriting each other (e847939c). A raw `.md` URL whose code fence shows `<body>` stays Markdown instead of being reduced to the example (6a92c1fd).
- **import-sources**: `.txt` sources in GB18030 or other non-UTF-8 encodings are decoded instead of replaced (39b470fe). Markdown with the same text but different companion images (`<stem>_files/`) is no longer treated as a duplicate and deleted (104bc3c9).
- **PPTX import**: `b="true"` / `i="true"` now import as bold and italic, as `"1"` already did (8bdf440c). Page-type classification matches whole words, so "Qatar" or "Department" no longer reads as a Q&A or chapter page (c0ce2420).

## Live preview editor

- Save All refuses to replay staged edits onto an SVG that changed after they were staged, keeping them staged with an error. Before, they landed on whichever element now sat at that position (05e627cb).
- User ids that start with `_edit_` are kept, and `dy=".5"`-style numbers are parsed correctly when a line is moved (264bd669).

## Export, finalize and checker

- Proportional fonts such as Arial Unicode MS and Monotype Corsiva are no longer sized as monospace (c2668566).
- Icons and illustrations marked with single-quoted `preserve-color` or `stroke='currentColor'` keep their colors and style (05cf79cd, 0cdf8765).
- The checker no longer fails a slide whose visible text reads `class=…`, `onload=…` or `@import …`, or that carries a `data-class` attribute. Real `class`, event and CSS-import usage still fails (8f00128e, 923a5360).

## Images, narration and video

- Manifest images named like `hero.v2.png` no longer overwrite `hero.png` (e9676c5a).
- Image search ranks by whole words: required "Iran" no longer accepts "Tirana", and the transit penalty no longer hits "business" or "trail" (d4ac79df, b827c5ce).
- Page subtitles and notes follow numeric slide order past slide 9 and slide 99 (1036fd53). Narration keeps lines such as `#1 revenue grew` and skips only real Markdown headings (06008e8e).

## Docs

- The FAQ no longer promises pixel-identical charts in Keynote, LibreOffice and WPS; Microsoft PowerPoint is the validation target (ac16c041).

name: v6.7.1
body:
Patch release: fixes for work that the live preview, source conversion and source import could lose without a warning, plus a full pass over the UI strings in every language.

## Live preview

- **Unapplied annotations and direct edits now survive a server stop** (1fa3768a, #319). Before, they lived only in server memory, and the idle timeout, Exit preview, `--shutdown`, a kill or a crash before Apply changes discarded them. Closing a laptop lid made this likely: the idle timer counted the suspend time, so the server exited on wake.
  - Every staging change is written to `live_preview/draft.json` before it is acknowledged. The next start restores it and the UI lists the restored slides; you still decide when to apply.
  - A slide whose SVG changed in the meantime is not replayed onto it. Its draft is kept as `live_preview/draft_conflict_<timestamp>.json` and the UI says so.
  - Exit preview now keeps the draft instead of discarding it. A failed draft write is reported in the UI.
  - Apply changes keeps a slide staged when an annotated element no longer exists, instead of dropping the annotation. SVGs are written atomically, and a submit that finds nothing pending on the server is reported instead of shown as saved.

## Source conversion and import

- Direct PDF/document/Excel/PowerPoint batches without `-o` no longer let same-stem inputs (`budget.xlsx` + `budget.xlsm`) overwrite each other's Markdown while reporting success (8d630fff, #317).
- `import-sources` gives same-stem sources distinct archive stems, so the second one is converted and reaches the project (ca04346d).
- Notebook output images go to `<output-stem>_files/`, so notebooks converted side by side no longer overwrite each other's images (e4a4c084).

## UI strings and prompts

- Corrected the Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Japanese UI strings across the confirmation, spec review and live preview pages: meaning errors, stale strings, punctuation and consistent terms. Two stale English source strings were also fixed, and translation keys that nothing reads were dropped (5d613ea2, ecb6269b, bc3f51df, 5d806d29, df82a224, b6843645).
- Workflow triggers, templates and candidate keys now follow the repo language rule (a5170959). The user docs no longer say the communication recommendation is written without reading any template content (667b032b). The Chinese docs are resynced with their English sources (e0e6576d, 0b898cd8).
- Thanks to @kevindesuyo for the whole UI-string and docs pass.

name: v5.1.35
body:
**The omo-senpi typecheck gives the same result wherever the checkout sits.** It used to pick up `@types/node` from folders above the checkout, so a stray older copy there failed the typecheck while CI passed on the same commit. omo-senpi now declares its own `@types/node` and `bun-types` and reads type packages only from its own `node_modules`. ([#10320](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10320), [#10332](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10332))

**Memory items sync without losing concurrent edits, even from a stale device.** The sync item model captures a device's edits against the exact snapshot it saw, so a stale capture merges as a concurrent edit instead of silently dropping work or throwing; two captures from one device on one baseline lose nothing, multiline and quoted frontmatter values render as valid YAML on every replica, and path keys that would split one file into several (empty segments, trailing slashes, backslashes, drive letters) are rejected instead of canonicalized. Nothing syncs to a server yet. ([#10203](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10203))

**A `categories` entry named after an agent now gets a warning instead of being silently ignored.** A `task(subagent_type: "plan-consultant")` spawn reads only `agents."plan-consultant"`, so a model chain put under `categories."plan-consultant"` never reached it and the spawn ran the builtin chain, while `omo doctor` still counted that category as usable. Whenever a `categories.<name>` key equals a builtin agent or an agent in your `agents` config, and that agent does not already set its own models, the startup notice and `omo doctor` now say that key is not read for that spawn and show the corrected snippet with your own chain, for example `"agents": { "plan-consultant": { "models": [...] } }`; `agents.<name>.models` stays the one way to set an agent's models. Resolution is unchanged. Thanks to @Bearmancer for the report. ([#10323](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10323), [#10326](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10326))

**A steering message to a background task is never recorded as both failed and delivered.** When a steer timed out and its retry was still in flight while a later run of the parent reconciled the task's unconfirmed inputs, that run marked the message failed and the retry then delivered it, so the task's log said both. Reconciliation now leaves an input whose retry is in flight to that retry, which records the one real outcome ([#10165](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10165)).

**Memory reflection no longer dies in the sandbox when its session directory does not exist yet.** The Linux sandbox now creates each writable directory it binds (mode 0700) right before bwrap binds it, and every reflection launch first backfills the identity's runtime directories, so an identity created before `runtime/reflection-sessions` existed reflects normally instead of failing with "Can't find source path". An off or unavailable sandbox still creates nothing. Thanks to [@leeseunguk](https://github.com/leeseunguk) and [@AceRothstein71](https://github.com/AceRothstein71) (#7236). ([#7012](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/7012), [#8004](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/8004))

**A missing reflection directory no longer gets "turn the sandbox off" advice.** When memory reflection fails because a sandbox bind directory does not exist yet, the notice now names that directory and how to create it, instead of blaming user namespaces and suggesting `memory.reflection.sandbox: "off"`. A real user-namespace refusal still gets the host fix first, with turning the sandbox off only as a last resort. ([#10317](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10317), [#10319](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10319))

**Opening and closing an OmO session without a message no longer leaves an empty session in `/resume`.** The memory component's hidden session binding is now written as startup bookkeeping, so senpi removes a session that never had a conversation. ([#10168](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10168), [#10308](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10308))

**A task shard host now exits once its children are done instead of staying alive for days.** When a task child's session parked or closed on its shard, the child's own connection to that shard stayed open, so the shard kept counting the connections and its idle exit never fired; one shard served zero sessions for two days with 18 connections back to itself. Those connections now close when the session ends, and a refused close no longer strands its client ([#10062](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10062), [#10066](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10066)).

**Computer use can hold keys or a mouse button for a set time and always lets go.** `holdKeys(keys, { duration })` and `holdMouse(x, y, { duration })` hold for up to 100 seconds and release everything they pressed, in reverse order, even when the run is cancelled or the emergency stop fires. ([#9651](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9651), [#10030](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10030))

**A child task keeps reporting the model it is actually running.** A `set_model` or model cycle applied to a child by any client, and a fallback that later reverts, now update the child's record as they happen: `task_output`, `/tasks`, the desktop task snapshot and the completion notice show the live model, and a switch omo did not make is marked `(switched by operator)`. The persisted record keeps `effective_model.source` within the values earlier builds parse (the live switch detail moves into a nested block those builds ignore), so a downgrade or an older omo sharing the task store still loads these records. ([#10020](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10020), [#10097](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10097))

**`OMO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1` turns OmO Native telemetry fully off, and an opted-out session leaves nothing behind for a later one to send.** Every opt-out (`OMO_DISABLE_TELEMETRY`, `DO_NOT_TRACK`, the PostHog switches and the config flag) now goes through one consent check, taken when the session starts and again before anything is written or hashed: an opted-out session derives no session hash, creates no salt or notice marker, and writes no summary file. Events now carry a time-ordered random `event_id`, are keyed by a hash of the install id instead of the machine (the old machine hash rides along until 2026-12-14 so earlier rows still join), and mark CI runs with a plain `ci` flag. Turning telemetry off while a session is running now stops that session's events within a few seconds, including the raw per-turn row a sampled session kept sending ([#10328](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10328)). QA drivers that start the real runtime opt out of telemetry through one shared helper. ([#10226](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10226))

Fixed: OmO Native versions v5.0.0-beta.6 through v5.1.34 kept sending usage events for the rest of a session after telemetry was turned off while that session was running ([#10328](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10328)). These events are personless and carry a session hash; the ones confirmed in that report are `turn_completed`, `feature_used` and `computer_use_activation`, other usage events may have been sent the same way, and like every OmO Native event they never contain prompt or response text, file paths, or file contents. Turning telemetry off before a session started, or through one of the opt-out environment variables, was never affected. Since v5.1.35 consent is checked when events are sent (a check is reused for at most 5 seconds), and events already queued are dropped once the opt-out is read. Those events can't be told apart from consented ones, so erasure is per install: send a private request through this repository's [private vulnerability reporting form](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/security/advisories/new), titled "Telemetry erasure request", with your install id (the file `omo-senpi/omo-native/install-id` under the agent home), and an operator erases that install's events. Put the id only in that private report, never in a public issue or comment. Events from older versions that are keyed only by the machine hash are erased along with your install's events only where our records pair that hash with your install id and no other install. A history shared by several machines or installs (the same hostname hash) is not erased that way: name it in the private request, and it is erased only if the request proves the events are yours. ([#10226](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10226))

**Sessions load about 33 KB less code at startup, because the memory palace and `/people` now load on first use.** The `/palace` viewer generator and the `/people` roster, record and `--ask` runtime moved out of the entry bundle into their own file, which is loaded the first time either command runs, the same way `/doctor` and `/memfs` already work. Both commands print and notify exactly what they did before. If that file is missing or broken, the command now says so and tells you to reinstall omo and start a new session, instead of failing silently. ([#10300](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10300))

**The memory sync device keyring refuses a few more malformed inputs instead of failing late.** A keyring record can no longer carry the snapshot tag as its type, deeply nested JSON (over 64 levels) is refused with a typed error instead of a stack overflow, the wrap associated data goes through the one RFC 8785 serializer and refuses a non-integer epoch, and a low-order X25519 point is refused with the normal "does not open" error. Follow-up to the review of [#10194](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10194) ([#10274](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10274)).

**Background task reattachment now recovers the real result instead of starting duplicate work.** A parent that reloads or loses its host connection checks whether the child is still running before reading its transcript. Finished turns are adopted once, interrupted turns continue once, and a turn stopped by its deadline stays interrupted until an explicit `task_send`. ([#10012](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10012), [#10013](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10013), [#10078](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10078)).

**The ulw-research report checker no longer counts an invisible image as the report's visual.** An image or chart with any zero dimension, such as `width="600" height="0"` or an inline `height: 0`, no longer satisfies the rule that every final report carries a visual; one with no declared size still counts, since the browser sizes it. ([#10266](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10266), [#10268](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10268))

**Computer use no longer asks to confirm foreground control in full access mode.** A full-access session grants it directly and shows a note with the reason; other modes still ask, headless runs still never grant, and the grant still ends with the turn, on release or on the stop chord. Reported by Q. ([#10022](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/10022), [#10024](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/10024))

**`omo update` no longer offers to overwrite a binary your package manager installed.** When the compiled `omo` is owned by pacman, dpkg, rpm, Homebrew or Nix, `omo update` used to print a `curl … && mv` replace command that either failed on a root-owned path or left the package manager tracking a file it no longer installed. It now exits non-zero and names the package and the manager's own upgrade command (for example `brew upgrade omo`). The ownership probe fails open: a missing tool or an unowned path keeps the old behavior. Thanks to @cynkai. ([#9585](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9585), [#9629](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9629))

**Memory reflection notices name the failing run's log by its real path.** The parked notice, the reflection-failing health alert and `/memory doctor` told you to inspect `runtime/reflection-sessions/<runId>/child-stderr.log`, a relative path with a literal `<runId>` under a directory runs are not kept in. They now name the newest failing run's absolute `child-stderr.log` (home shortened to `~`), and when that run was already pruned they say so and point at the stderr tail kept in the failure detail. Thanks to @cynkai. ([#9497](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/9497), [#9505](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/9505))

name: SDK v0.0.95
body:
- OpenAI-compatible requests for GPT-6 models (`gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-6.1-sol`, `gpt-6-1-sol`, and later gpt-5 through gpt-9 ids) send `max_completion_tokens` instead of `max_tokens`, so OpenAI and Azure no longer reject them. Azure's `gpt-35-turbo` keeps `max_tokens`
- The hub daemon records which client started it (`CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_CLIENT`, `CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_VERSION`, `CLINE_HUB_LAUNCHER_TRANSPORT`) and publishes that as OTel resource attributes. SSH remote hubs report the local client with transport `ssh`. `@cline/shared` adds `withHubLauncherIdentity`, `claimHubLauncherIdentity` and `readHubLauncherIdentity`
- The telemetry self-check report includes `traces_exporter`
- Refreshed the model catalog (6,952 → 7,041 models). Adds the CommandCode and Reflection providers. The Cline recommended list leads with Claude Sonnet 5.5 again, so the `cline` provider's bundled default goes back to Claude Sonnet 5.5 from Gemini 4 Argon. Default models change for 302.AI (Gemini 4 Argon), Eden AI and Prime Inference (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave (Reflection Beam 1.0), NanoGPT, Pioneer (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), and Scaleway (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). OpenCode Go keeps its `https://opencode.ai/inference/go/v1` base URL, now pinned, because models.dev moved its provider-level URL to an OpenAI-only path

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.94...sdk/sdk/v0.0.95

name: Desktop v0.0.48
body:

- The Cline provider's default model is Claude Sonnet 5.5 again, which is back at the top of Cline's recommended list
- Refreshed the model catalog. Adds the CommandCode and Reflection providers. Default models change for 302.AI (Gemini 4 Argon), Eden AI and Prime Inference (Muse Spark Open), CoreWeave (Reflection Beam 1.0), NanoGPT, Pioneer (Nemotron 3.5 Super VL), and Scaleway (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash)

name: v13.41.0
body:
# Build, release, and work-state visibility

## Workflow skills

- `build` delegates a coding session through `make-plan`, `do`, and `babysit`.
- `release` delegates publication through `version-bump` and `childhood`.
- `build-and-release` runs both, merging the ready PR before continuing from updated main.
- Restores the existing `childhood` skill so post-release verification is included.

The new wrappers are deliberately short. They reuse the existing workflows.

## Work-state telemetry

Adds privacy-preserving PostHog rollups for work-state usage by release, host platform, and recorded agent role. The rollups distinguish captured reads and writes, outcomes, native to-do use, instruction handoffs, and missing attribution.

MCP execution receipts also cover failures before a worker responds. They are a separate observation source and must not be added to captured-call totals.

Instruction handoffs are measured after the platform adapter formats the model-bound output and stdout succeeds. Cached context is included; discarded context and failed output are not counted as successful handoffs. Delayed or untimestamped captures cannot inherit a later instruction handoff.

These are diagnostic signals, not a compliance score. Returning instructions does not prove that a host accepted them or an agent followed them, and an ordinary question may correctly require no write.

No task titles, prompt text, project paths, or raw session/agent IDs are sent. Existing telemetry opt-out remains in effect. This release does not backfill earlier usage.

Local replay deduplication lasts 30 days; older events are dropped. Public/private turn boundaries remain content-free and prevent private activity from inheriting an earlier public prompt. Hosts without verified original timestamps remain outside captured prompt/tool totals.

name: v0.2.1-rc.1
body:
[中文](#cn-v0.2.1-rc.1-community) | [English](#en-v0.2.1-rc.1-community) 作为 `0.2.1` 系列的首个候选版本，本版本汇总了自 `v0.2.0-rc.2` 以来的主要用户和开发者相关变更。

新增功能

- 允许用户从“自定义插件索引源”中发现和安装插件。 @turtle1999 - 插件管理页新增「让 Agent 创建插件」入口，可保留草稿进入创造模式；发送需求后才开始执行。 @ZiyaZhang - 支持插件启用、停用、卸载及更新后的依赖同步；启用热重载时，更新或重新安装的可替换插件直接生效，无法热重载时提示重启。 @imccyu, @turtle1999 - 可选插件支持极简模式，Official 插件列表支持按需安装与当前发布版对应的 Claude Code 和 Codex 组合包，并可用于 headless、SDK 和 ACP profile。 @tianyicui, @turtle2099 - 新增实验性插件的 Session 状态记录接口，供插件写入和读取自己的会话记录。 @tianyicui - 新增实验性 Claude Code Mods 兼容层。目前阶段的主要目的是验证 Claude Code Mods API 功能大致为 DeepSeek Harness 插件的一个子集，而非为用户提供实际的完整兼容性。 @tianyicui - 新增实验性开发者工具组合包，提供会话原始日志、聊天分组与正文的双向定位，以及内嵌 NodeJS 调试工具；内嵌 DevTools 目前使用英文界面。 @imccyu, @turtle2099 - 新增实验性思考过程机器翻译插件，可在插件页启用，选择 Bing、Google 或付费 DeepSeek Flash。 @tianyicui, @ZiyaZhang, @imccyu - 新增实验性 Git Worktrees 插件，可在插件页启用，由 Agent 创建并进入独立的 Git checkout。 @tianyicui, @turtle2099 - 自定义模型 API 支持通过UI中配置各模型的推理等级，无需手动修改配置文件。 @LegGasai - pi-ai 路由支持按模型能力处理会话中的系统提示词更新，以及工具的动态新增和移除。 @Tuyixiang - 极简模式支持读取图片和自动压缩长对话，Web 与桌面端可通过 /compact 指令手动压缩上下文。 @LogosVeritas - 全局指令支持读取共享 agents 目录中的 AGENTS.md，可通过 DSH_AGENTS_HOME 指定目录。 @tianyicui - 新增 working_directory 工具，并为 TypeScript/Python SDK 提供会话工作目录的读取和切换接口。 @tianyicui - SSH 新增独立可执行的 helper 运行时，支持远端文件操作、进程、终端、沙箱和 Node PTC。 @LegGasai - Web 版支持在本机 HTTP 访问时登录 DeepSeek 账号。 @lsdsjy - 支持识别已发送消息中的密钥和令牌，并默认脱敏按需查看。 @ZiyaZhang - 新会话支持预填未发送的提示；恢复草稿或切换工作区时保留文件、目录和会话引用。 @imccyu - 新增工作步骤收起时机设置，可选择回答结束后收起，或在下一条普通消息到来时收起。 @imccyu - Markdown 文件预览将 YAML 头部元数据显示为清晰的字段列表。 @turtle2099 ### 体验优化 - 改善自动化任务详情在窄窗口中的布局，关联会话入口会按可用空间收起为图标。 @turtle2099 - 子智能体可通过配置选用独立 Agent Preset 预设，统一设置角色和工具； @grllll, @Dudu-0223 - 改进子智能体的委派与等待指引：达到委派层数上限时提前提示，等待子任务期间不再消耗新的目标执行轮次。 @ZiyaZhang, @turtle1999 - 组合包详情页显示代码来源和当前版本，便于查看安装来源及重装所需的信息。 @turtle1999 - 插件安装结果显示实际安装版本；因新版本冷却策略安装较旧版本时，提供说明和精确版本安装方式。 @turtle2099 - 工具调用在准备阶段即可显示已到达的命令说明、文件路径和内容生成进度。 @imccyu - Shell 和插件安装详情支持横向查看及复制完整命令；后台 Bash 调用可展开输入和启动回执。 @tianyicui - Web 终端更可靠地处理连续输入、粘贴和尺寸调整，并保留进程退出前的最后输出。 @LegGasai - PTC Mode 的 Node 执行环境新增可选的 in-memory 模式，多次运行代码可复用变量、函数和已导入模块。 @CreatixChu - 改善大量会话的列表加载与 @ 会话搜索体验。 @turtle1999, @imccyu - 优化自动会话标题生成，对同主题的追问、补充和继续请求保留已有合适标题。 @tianyicui, @ZiyaZhang - 侧栏 Fork 和子代理目录浏览新增迁移提示，遇到需要迁移的会话时引导用户先打开原会话。 @imccyu - 优化侧栏展开规则，让运行中和等待回应的会话更容易找到；会话菜单支持复制会话 ID。 @turtle1999, @imccyu - 支持分别设置界面正文、代码与工具输出、侧栏终端的字体和字号；桌面端可通过 Cmd/Ctrl + 加号或减号统一调整字号。 @turtle2099, @koalazf99 - 优化会话和工作区的悬停操作，统一卡片与菜单样式，并改善页头排列及插件页、自动化任务页的窄窗口布局。 @Yifffan, @Kingwl - 语音输入新增麦克风选择，可在插件详情页选择输入设备，并查看所选设备的实时输入电平。 @yudshj - 允许远程主机访问的 Web 配置使用页面内目录选择器，不再在服务器上弹出原生目录对话框。 @oraluben - 优化含超长源码行的文件预览性能，超长行使用无高亮文本展示，普通行继续进行语法高亮。 @turtle2099 - Office 文档任务按需加载编辑、渲染和导出指引，减少简单修改及 PDF 导出后的无关检查与预览，并避免在回复中引用已删除的预览图。 @yudshj - DeepSeek 账号的模型列表随账号可用模型更新，并隐藏当前客户端版本不支持的模型。 @LegGasai - 模型设置更清楚地提示凭据来源和检测状态，支持按需显示输入的 API Key。 @Magolor ### 问题修复 - 目标编辑支持多行文本和 Shift+Enter 换行，并改善目标与排队消息编辑器的中文输入及宽度适配。 @turtle2099 - 修复目标任务停止、恢复并再次停止后，新消息滞留队列的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 Trajectory 将等待、流式输出或重试中的请求标为完成，以及压缩任务提前显示结果的问题。 @turtle2099, @kermanx - 修复后台工作流仍在运行，却因父级工具步骤或对话轮次正常结束而被标为已中断的问题。 @turtle2099 - 恢复可继续子代理输入栏的图片粘贴和拖放，支持运行中追加图片和完成后发送图片续发消息。 @ZiyaZhang - 应用意外退出后，未完成的任务会明确显示“任务已停止”，避免被误认为正常完成。 @turtle2099 - 修复部分 Bash、PowerShell 和文件修改记录无法展开输出或差异的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复凭据、配置和技能文件监听器关闭后的未捕获异常，以及 Agent 关闭时资源提前释放的问题。 @tianyicui, @kermanx - 修复部分 Windows 环境下，持久 PowerShell 在大量输出滚屏后迟迟无法结束当前调用的问题。 @Chinesezjc - 修复 Windows Desktop 终端退出后，PTY 后台工作进程未随之清理的问题。 @winewill - 减少 Linux 下启动命令前的重复检查，降低命令启动开销，并改善较旧 systemd 环境的兼容性。 @imccyu - 修复命令执行失败时，未呈现有效的状态信息。 @yudshj - 减少新建与恢复多个终端时的重复查询，并避免失效终端在切换面板后反复重试。 @LegGasai - 改善 PTC Mode 中缺失的部分指引，并统一 SDK、Web 和 headless 的模型身份说明。 @koalazf99 - 关闭代码工作视图后仍可选择标准、创造和自定义模式；内置 PTC／极简默认值改为标准，已有会话保持原模式。 @ZiyaZhang - 修复启停插件时其他插件的样式被移除、需要刷新页面才能恢复的问题。 @turtle2099 - 启用开发目录监听后，HMR 可刷新包入口和依赖映射配置，并正确重载仍在运行的原入口。 @imccyu - 修复在插件页启用或停用插件后，已打开会话的 `/` 菜单未更新技能列表的问题。 @grllll - 登录请求未收到响应时显示网络检查提示，便于区分连接问题与其他登录失败。 @lsdsjy - 修复模型响应流停止输出、且底层传输不响应取消时，请求超过空闲超时仍一直挂起的问题。 @tianyicui - 修复插件包元信息不可读，或辅助请求扩展准备失败时，整个 DeepSeek 请求被阻断的问题。 @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - 修复模型设置刷新期间仍可基于旧数据编辑或删除配置，导致刚保存的选择未出现在编辑器中的问题。 @tianyicui - 凭据文件中出现 DSH 不使用的额外字段时，不再阻止应用启动。 @turtle2099 - 桌面端默认使用系统分配的端口，避免 Windows 保留端口范围导致应用无法启动。 @turtle2099 - 修复展开右侧栏后，会话标题栏中的后台任务列表被侧栏遮挡或裁切的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 Windows Desktop 图片预览遮罩及关闭按钮与标题栏重叠、侧栏按钮悬停圆角不一致的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 Windows 安装器对磁盘根目录的校验，拒绝带重复末尾路径分隔符的根目录写法。 @tianyicui - 修复 macOS 应用的小尺寸 Finder 图标，以及复制和替换应用提示中的图标损坏问题。 @07akioni - 修复 Windows 和 Linux 下右侧栏收起时，在输入框按 Page Up 导致整个界面向左偏移的问题。 @imccyu - 修复侧栏列表重排或重新显示后，会话加载动画不同步的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复 /goal、/plan 等命令与参数交界处的输入异常及草稿与显示不一致，支持整体选中、删除命令，并在撤销或刷新页面后恢复。 @LegGasai - 修复切换会话、收起工作过程或发送后续消息时，对话区域出现大块空白、滚动跳动的问题。 @imccyu - 修复重启应用后部分会话无法继续，以及切换到 DeepSeek 后因历史消息兼容问题导致请求失败的情况。 @imccyu, @yudshj - 修复 macOS 添加工作区时目录选择器无法粘贴目录路径，以及取消选择仍添加工作区的问题。 @turtle2099 - 修复原预设被删除或调整后，恢复空白会话、切换工作区可能失败的问题。 @LegGasai - 修复卸载会话存储插件时，最后的会话记录可能丢失的问题。 @turtle1999 - 修复本地 SenseVoice 语音识别开启 VAD 后，录音开头被截断、首字或音节丢失的问题。 @yudshj - 修复远程 Web 在网络拥塞时被误判为断线，以及刷新后语言、主题等偏好丢失的问题。 @turtle2099, @oraluben ### 其他变更 - API Key 读取优先级变更：Web端/桌面端优先采用已保存的凭据；headless 默认改用环境变量和 .env，不读取已保存的密钥。 @Magolor - 移除运行时 invariant 插件及各包的 `./invariant` 导出；使用这些诊断入口的开发者需相应调整扩展或自定义 profile。 @turtle2099 - 子路径插件不再读取独立的 `package.json`，显示文本和图标须通过对应子路径导出；插件开发模板同步补齐本地化信息与图标。 @turtle1999 - 第三方插件的版本兼容性优先按 `engines.dsh` 判断；未声明时沿用原有规则。插件作者需检查声明是否覆盖支持的 DSH 版本。 @turtle1999 - 输入区统计扩展拆为 `activity` 和 `usage` 两个独立入口；覆盖旧 `stats` 整行的插件需要更新注册 ID。 @turtle1999 - 为用户消息、文本与图片展示、新会话页及模型选择器添加扩展位，支持插件定制对应内容。 @imccyu, @LegGasai - 自动化任务改为 Web 内置能力，提醒工具按模式提供：标准、创造和 PTC 模式可用，极简模式和子代理不可用；旧实验组合包选择会自动清理，已有任务保留。 @Chinesezjc, @turtle1999 - 关闭计划审阅以补充修改意见时，直接结束当前轮次并等待用户反馈，避免额外调用模型。 @turtle2099 - 统一子代理执行与完成通知，工具立即返回 child ID；自定义 SDK runtime 需支持 session/wait。 @Dudu-0223 - Agent Team 消息改为直接投递目标 Inbox，移除独立 outbox、自动重试和重发去重；相关配置与结果字段需迁移。 @Dudu-0223 - Python PTC 接入 Session 文件沙箱策略；自定义组合需提供 sandbox 和 sandboxPolicy 服务。 @tianyicui - 移除工具展示的 both 混合模式，仅保留 native 和 ptc；使用旧模式的配置与 API 调用需要更新。 @tianyicui - 移除 agent-instructions 插件逐行 dshHome 配置，指令目录改从进程的 DSH_HOME 或默认目录读取。 @tianyicui - 默认 SDK profile 从固定的编程 Agent 改为通用 AI Agent 身份，适用于一般任务。 @Dudu-0223 - 使用 --from-default-profile 重建已有自定义配置时，会替换该配置及其插件和设置。 @turtle2099 - TypeScript 和 Python SDK 支持 resume 功能，恢复已保存的会话，继续使用原有会话 ID 和工作目录。 @koalazf99 - Python SDK 的 Office 引擎和完整创作环境改为按需下载。 @yudshj - 完善网关授权与连接机制，支持按调用方身份控制资源访问，并独立管理 API 连接及其交互参与方式。 @imccyu - Web 支持通过 `--public-url` 指定显示、打开及提供给模型的对外访问地址，支持带路径前缀的反向代理入口。 @oraluben - Web 支持绑定指定的 IPv4/IPv6 地址，并通过 --tls-cert 和 --tls-key 配置原生 HTTPS 监听。 @oraluben - pi-ai 更新至 1.0.2，包含上游模型目录更新和适配器修复。 @tianyicui - 更新第三方模型支持；Azure 提供方名称统一为 azure，使用旧名称 azure-openai-responses 的提供方配置需迁移。 @LegGasai - 更新运行时工具、MCP 协议、图片处理和客户端渲染依赖，纳入兼容版本的安全修复。 @tianyicui This first release candidate for 0.2.1 summarizes the major user- and developer-facing changes since v0.2.0-rc.2.

New Features

- Discover and install plugins from custom plugin index sources. by @turtle1999 - Add a “Let Agent create a plugin” entry to plugin management. It opens Creator mode while preserving the draft and starts work only after the request is sent. by @ZiyaZhang - Support dependency synchronization when plugins are enabled, disabled, uninstalled, or updated. With hot reload enabled, replaceable plugins take effect directly after an update or reinstallation; changes that cannot be hot-reloaded request a restart. by @imccyu, @turtle1999 - Support optional plugins in Minimal mode. The Official plugin catalog offers on-demand installation of Claude Code and Codex bundles matching the current release, for use in headless, SDK, and ACP profiles. by @tianyicui, @turtle2099 - Add Session state-record APIs for experimental plugins to write and read their own session records. by @tianyicui - Add an experimental Claude Code Mods compatibility layer. At this stage, the main goal is to verify that the Claude Code Mods API's capabilities are broadly a subset of what DeepSeek Harness plugins can do, rather than to offer users complete, practical compatibility. by @tianyicui - Add an experimental Developer Tools bundle with raw session logs, bidirectional navigation between chat groups and the conversation, and embedded NodeJS debugging tools. The embedded DevTools currently uses an English interface. by @imccyu, @turtle2099 - Add an experimental reasoning translation plugin, enabled from the Plugins page with Bing, Google, or paid DeepSeek Flash as the provider. by @tianyicui, @ZiyaZhang, @imccyu - Add an experimental Git Worktrees plugin that can be enabled on the Plugins page for Agents to create and enter separate Git checkouts. by @tianyicui, @turtle2099 - Configure reasoning levels for individual custom API models in the UI without editing configuration files manually. by @LegGasai - Support in-conversation system prompt updates and dynamic tool additions and removals on pi-ai routes according to model capabilities. by @Tuyixiang - Minimal mode can read images and automatically compact long conversations. Web and Desktop users can run the /compact command to compact context manually. by @LogosVeritas - Load global instructions from AGENTS.md in the shared agents directory, with DSH_AGENTS_HOME available to select its location. by @tianyicui - Add the working_directory tool and TypeScript/Python SDK APIs for reading and changing a session’s working directory. by @tianyicui - Add standalone executable SSH helper runtimes supporting remote file operations, processes, terminals, sandboxing, and Node PTC. by @LegGasai - The Web app supports DeepSeek account sign-in when accessed over local HTTP. by @lsdsjy - Detect keys and tokens in sent messages and mask them by default, with an option to reveal them. by @ZiyaZhang - Support unsent initial prompts for new sessions and preserve file, folder, and session references when restoring drafts or moving them between workspaces. by @imccyu - Add a setting to collapse work details either when the response finishes or when the next regular message arrives. by @imccyu - Display YAML frontmatter as a readable field list in Markdown file previews. by @turtle2099 ### Improvements - Improve Automation task details in narrow windows by collapsing the linked-session action to an icon when space is limited. by @turtle2099 - Configure spawned subagents with independent Agent Presets to manage their roles and tools together. by @grllll, @Dudu-0223 - Improve subagent delegation and waiting guidance: announce delegation depth limits in advance and wait for running subtasks before starting another goal round. by @ZiyaZhang, @turtle1999 - Show a bundle’s code source and current version in its details, making installation and reinstallation information easier to find. by @turtle1999 - Show the version actually installed and explain how to request an exact version when pnpm’s release-age policy selects an older release. by @turtle2099 - Show available command descriptions, file paths, and content-generation progress while tool calls are still preparing. by @imccyu - Support scrolling and copying full commands in Shell and plugin installation details, and expand background Bash inputs and launch receipts. by @tianyicui - Handle continuous input, pastes, and resizing more reliably in the Web terminal, and preserve the final output when a process exits. by @LegGasai - The Node runtime for PTC Mode adds an optional in-memory mode that reuses variables, functions, and imported modules across code executions. by @CreatixChu - Improve large session list loading and @ session search. by @turtle1999, @imccyu - Improve automatic session titles by retaining adequate titles for same-topic follow-ups, additional details, and requests to continue. by @tianyicui, @ZiyaZhang - Add migration guidance to sidebar forks and subagent catalog browsing, directing users to open the original session when migration is required. by @imccyu - Improve sidebar expansion so running sessions and sessions awaiting a response are easier to find. Session menus support copying the session ID. by @turtle1999, @imccyu - Choose fonts and sizes separately for interface text, code and tool output, and sidebar terminals. On Desktop, use Cmd/Ctrl + plus or minus to adjust font sizes together. by @turtle2099, @koalazf99 - Refine session and workspace hover interactions, unify card and menu styling, and improve header ordering and narrow-window layouts on plugin and automation pages. by @Yifffan, @Kingwl - Add microphone selection to voice input, with an input-device selector and live levels for the selected device in plugin details. by @yudshj - Use the in-page directory picker in Web configurations that allow remote hosts, instead of opening a native directory dialog on the server. by @oraluben - Improve previews of files containing overlong source lines, rendering those lines without syntax colors while regular lines retain highlighting. by @turtle2099 - Load Office editing, rendering, and export guidance as needed, reduce unrelated checks and previews for simple edits and after PDF export, and avoid referencing deleted preview images in replies. by @yudshj - Keep the DeepSeek account model list up to date with the models available to the account, while hiding models unsupported by the current client version. by @LegGasai - Model settings show clearer credential sources and detection status, and let users reveal an entered API key. by @Magolor ### Bug Fixes - Support multiline goal editing with Shift+Enter, and improve IME handling and resizing in goal and queued-message editors. by @turtle2099 - Fix new messages remaining queued after stopping, resuming, and stopping a goal-driven task again. by @turtle2099 - Fix Trajectory marking waiting, streaming, or retrying requests as completed and showing results before compaction tasks finish. by @turtle2099, @kermanx - Fix background workflows being marked interrupted while still running after their parent tool step or conversation turn ends normally. by @turtle2099 - Restore image paste and drop in continuable subagent composers, including images sent while running and follow-ups after completion. by @ZiyaZhang - Tasks interrupted by an application exit now show “Task stopped” instead of appearing to have completed normally. by @turtle2099 - Fix some Bash, PowerShell, and file-mutation records failing to expand their output or diff. by @turtle2099 - Fix uncaught errors after credential, configuration, and skill watchers close, and premature resource release during Agent shutdown. by @tianyicui, @kermanx - Fix persistent PowerShell calls failing to settle promptly after large amounts of output scroll in some Windows environments. by @Chinesezjc - Fix PTY worker processes remaining after a terminal exits in Windows Desktop. by @winewill - Reduce repeated checks before launching commands on Linux, lowering startup overhead and improving compatibility with older systemd environments. by @imccyu - Fix failed commands not displaying useful status information. by @yudshj - Reduce redundant queries when creating or restoring multiple terminals, and prevent failed terminals from retrying repeatedly when switching panels. by @LegGasai - Improve incomplete guidance in PTC Mode, and align model identity prompts across SDK, Web, and headless profiles. by @koalazf99 - Keep Standard, Creator, and custom modes available when coding view is disabled. Built-in PTC or Minimal defaults change to Standard, while existing sessions retain their mode. by @ZiyaZhang - Fix toggling a plugin removing styles owned by other plugins until the page is refreshed. by @turtle2099 - With development-directory watching enabled, refresh package-entry and dependency-mapping configuration while continuing to reload the entry that is already running. by @imccyu - Fix the skill list in an open Session’s `/` menu not updating after a plugin is enabled or disabled on the Plugins page. by @grllll - Show a network-check message when a sign-in request receives no response, distinguishing connection problems from other sign-in failures. by @lsdsjy - Fix requests remaining stuck beyond the idle timeout when a model response stream stops producing output and its transport ignores cancellation. by @tianyicui - Fix entire DeepSeek requests being blocked when plugin package metadata cannot be read or auxiliary request-extension preparation fails. by @turtle1999, @turtle2099 - Fix editing or deleting model settings from stale data during refresh, including newly saved selections missing from the editor. by @tianyicui - Extra fields that DSH does not use in the credentials file no longer prevent the application from starting. by @turtle2099 - Let the operating system assign the Desktop port by default, avoiding startup failures caused by reserved port ranges on Windows. by @turtle2099 - Fix the background job list in the session header being obscured or clipped when the right sidebar is expanded. by @turtle2099 - Fix Windows Desktop image-preview masks and close buttons overlapping the caption, and inconsistent sidebar-button hover corners. by @turtle2099 - Fix drive-root validation in the Windows installer to reject root paths containing repeated trailing separators. by @tianyicui - Fix corrupt small Finder icons for the macOS app and icons shown in application copy and replacement dialogs. by @07akioni - Fix Page Up in a text input shifting the entire interface to the left on Windows and Linux when the right sidebar is collapsed. by @imccyu - Keep session loading animations synchronized after sidebar rows move or become visible again. by @turtle2099 - Fix input errors and draft/display mismatches between commands such as /goal or /plan and their arguments. Commands can be selected and deleted as a whole, and restored after undo or a page reload. by @LegGasai - Fix large blank areas and scroll jumps when switching sessions, collapsing work details, or sending follow-up messages. by @imccyu - Fix failures when continuing some sessions after an application restart, and history compatibility errors when switching to DeepSeek. by @imccyu, @yudshj - Fix pasting directory paths into the directory picker when adding a workspace on macOS, and prevent cancelled selections from adding a workspace. by @turtle2099 - Fix failures when restoring a blank session or switching workspaces after its original preset was removed or changed. by @LegGasai - Fix a case where final session records could be lost while unloading the session storage plugin. by @turtle1999 - Fix clipped recording onsets and missing initial words or syllables in local SenseVoice transcription with VAD enabled. by @yudshj - Fix false disconnects during network congestion and lost language, theme, and other preferences after refreshing a remote Web client. by @turtle2099, @oraluben ### Chores - Change API key precedence: Web and Desktop prioritize saved credentials. Headless uses environment variables and .env files by default, without reading saved keys. by @Magolor - Remove runtime invariant plugins and package `./invariant` exports. Developers using these diagnostic entry points need to update their extensions or custom profiles accordingly. by @turtle2099 - Stop reading separate `package.json` files for subpath plugins; display text and icons must use the corresponding subpath exports. Plugin-development templates now include localized metadata and icons. by @turtle1999 - Third-party plugin compatibility prioritizes `engines.dsh` when declared and otherwise uses the existing rules. Plugin authors should check that the declared range covers their supported DSH versions. by @turtle1999 - Split composer statistics into separate `activity` and `usage` extension entries. Plugins replacing the former `stats` row must update their registered IDs. by @turtle1999 - Add extension points for user messages, text and image rendering, the new-session page, and the model selector, allowing plugins to customize their content. by @imccyu, @LegGasai - Make Automation tasks part of Web, with reminder tools scoped to Standard, Creator, and PTC modes. Minimal mode and subagents do not receive them. Retired experimental-bundle selections are cleaned up while existing tasks are preserved. by @Chinesezjc, @turtle1999 - End the current turn and wait for user feedback when a plan review is dismissed to request changes, avoiding an extra model call. by @turtle2099 - Unify subagent execution and completion notifications, with tools returning child IDs immediately. Custom SDK runtimes must support session/wait. by @Dudu-0223 - Deliver Agent Team messages directly to the target Inbox, removing the separate outbox, automatic retries, and resend deduplication. Migrate affected configuration and result fields. by @Dudu-0223 - Apply Session filesystem sandbox policies to Python PTC; custom compositions require sandbox and sandboxPolicy services. by @tianyicui - Remove the both mixed tool-presentation mode, leaving native and ptc. Update configurations and API calls that use the removed mode. by @tianyicui - Remove the per-row dshHome setting from agent-instructions and resolve instruction directories from the process DSH_HOME or its default. by @tianyicui - Change the default SDK profile from a fixed coding-agent persona to a general AI Agent identity for general-purpose tasks. by @Dudu-0223 - Using --from-default-profile to recreate an existing custom profile replaces that profile, including its plugins and settings. by @turtle2099 - The TypeScript and Python SDKs support session resume, restoring saved sessions with their original session IDs and working directories. by @koalazf99 - The Python SDK’s Office engine and full authoring environment are now downloaded on demand. by @yudshj - Improve gateway authorization and connection management with caller-based resource access control and independent API connections whose participation in user interactions can be configured. by @imccyu - Add `--public-url` for the Web address shown to users, opened in the browser, and supplied to the model, including reverse-proxy URLs with a path prefix. by @oraluben - Allow Web to bind to a specific IPv4/IPv6 address and configure native HTTPS listeners through --tls-cert and --tls-key. by @oraluben - Update pi-ai to 1.0.2, including upstream model-catalog updates and adapter fixes. by @tianyicui - Update third-party model support and rename the Azure provider to azure. Provider configurations using azure-openai-responses must be migrated. by @LegGasai - Update runtime utilities, MCP protocol integrations, image processing, and client-rendering dependencies with compatible security fixes. by @tianyicui Full Changelog: [dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2...dsh-v0.2.1-rc.1](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2...dsh-v0.2.1-rc.1)

name: supervision-0.31.0
body: # v0.31.0 — Depth, moving cameras and pose mAP supervision now sees depth: load depth maps from your model or stereo rig, measure how far each object is, and draw the map. - **`sv.DepthMap`** measures the distance to every detection and colours depth over any image, no OpenCV needed. - **`PolygonZone`** and `LineZone` keep counting in the right place while the camera pans. - **`KeyPointMeanAveragePrecision`** scores pose models the way `pycocotools` does. - **Kosmos-2**, Gemini 3.6/3.7 and MediaPipe hands now load straight into `Detections` and `KeyPoints`. - **`MeanAveragePrecision`** runs far faster on crowded images and lets you raise the detection cap. It's a drop-in upgrade if 0.30.x showed you no deprecation warnings, apart from four output changes. `sv.ByteTrack` with the `supervision.tracker` package, `supervision.keypoint`, `sv.LMM`, the legacy `sv.MeanAveragePrecision` and a few helpers are gone; the Migration guide has the swaps. ## ✨ Spotlights / highlights ### Depth maps: load, measure and draw `sv.DepthMap` holds metric depth, stereo disparity or relative depth for one frame, and keeps track of which one it is. `sv.DepthCamera` converts disparity to metres, `measure_detections` writes the median depth under each object to `detections.data` (`"depth_m"` when the map can give metres), and `sv.DepthAnnotator` colours the map over an image without OpenCV. `sv.DepthClipRange` keeps one colour scale across a whole video, so colours don't flicker between frames. Loaders read Roboflow Inference, Ultralytics, Transformers, and 16-bit PNG and PFM dataset files such as KITTI and Middlebury. (#2691, #2692, #2693, #2694) ```python import numpy as np import supervision as sv depth = np.full((100, 100), 20.0, dtype=np.float32) depth[20:40, 20:40] = 4.0 depth_map = sv.DepthMap(depth, kind="depth_m") detections = sv.Detections(xyxy=np.array([[20, 20, 40, 40], [60, 60, 90, 90]], dtype=float)) detections = depth_map.measure_detections(detections) detections.data["depth_m"] # array([ 4., 20.], dtype=float32) annotated = sv.DepthAnnotator().annotate(np.zeros((100, 100, 3), np.uint8), depth_map) ``` ### Zones that follow the camera Zones used to assume a fixed camera; when it panned, the scene slid out from under the zone. `PolygonZone.trigger` and `LineZone.trigger` now take an optional per-frame `coord_transform` that maps detection anchors back into the frame the zone was drawn on. Any object with `abs_to_rel` and `rel_to_abs` works, as described by the new `sv.CoordinatesTransformation` protocol, including the transformations from the `trackers` motion estimator. Drawing is unchanged, and `coord_transform=None` keeps current results. (#2657) ```python import numpy as np import supervision as sv class CameraShift: def abs_to_rel(self, points): return points + [50, 0] def rel_to_abs(self, points): return points - [50, 0] zone = sv.PolygonZone(polygon=np.array([[0, 0], [100, 0], [100, 100], [0, 100]])) car = sv.Detections(xyxy=np.array([[120.0, 40.0, 140.0, 60.0]])) zone.trigger(car) # array([False]) zone.trigger(car, coord_transform=CameraShift()) # array([ True]) ``` ### COCO keypoint mAP for pose models `sv.metrics.KeyPointMeanAveragePrecision` scores `sv.KeyPoints` predictions by Object Keypoint Similarity at ten thresholds from 0.50 to 0.95, and its scores agree with `pycocotools` `COCOeval(..., "keypoints")`. COCO greedy matching is now vectorized for box and keypoint mAP. In the benchmark reported with that change, one image with 1000 predictions and a 1000-detection cap dropped from 35.9 s to 0.5 s. `MeanAveragePrecision` also takes `max_detection_thresholds` for scenes with more than 100 objects. (#2687, #2733, #2716) ```python import numpy as np import supervision as sv from supervision.metrics import KeyPointMeanAveragePrecision targets = sv.KeyPoints( xy=np.array([[[10, 10], [60, 10], [35, 80]]], dtype=np.float32), class_id=np.array([0]), data={"area": np.array([4000.0])}, ) predictions = sv.KeyPoints( xy=np.array([[[11, 10], [60, 12], [35, 79]]], dtype=np.float32), class_id=np.array([0]), detection_confidence=np.array([0.9]), ) metric = KeyPointMeanAveragePrecision(sigmas=[0.25, 0.25, 0.25]) metric.update(predictions, targets).compute().map50 # 1.0 ``` ### More models, and the matcher behind the metrics `sv.Detections.from_vlm` parses Kosmos-2 grounding results (`sv.VLM.KOSMOS_2`) and Gemini 3.6 and 3.7 structured boxes and polygon masks. `sv.KeyPoints.from_mediapipe` loads MediaPipe hand landmarks, with `class_id` 0 for a left hand and 1 for a right hand. `sv.match_detections` exposes the one-to-one greedy IoU matcher the metrics use, for comparing two models or auditing labels against predictions. (#1903, #2504, #2283, #2557) ```python import supervision as sv caption = "a snowman next to a fire" entities = [("a snowman", (0, 9), [(0.1, 0.2, 0.4, 0.9)]), ("a fire", (19, 25), [(0.5, 0.6, 0.8, 0.95)])] detections = sv.Detections.from_vlm(sv.VLM.KOSMOS_2, (caption, entities), resolution_wh=(640, 480)) pairs, unmatched_a, unmatched_b = sv.match_detections(detections_a, detections_b) ``` ## 🔄 Migration guide No breaking changes beyond the APIs deprecated in 0.26–0.28 and scheduled for removal in 0.31.0. If 0.30.x printed no deprecation warnings for your code, only the four output changes at the end of this section can affect it. | Removed | Use instead | | -- | -- | | `sv.ByteTrack` and the `supervision.tracker` package | `ByteTrackTracker` from the `trackers` package (`pip install trackers`); call `update()` instead of `update_with_detections()` | | `supervision.keypoint` | `supervision.key_points` | | `sv.LMM`, `Detections.from_lmm` | `sv.VLM`, `Detections.from_vlm` | | legacy `sv.MeanAveragePrecision` (`supervision.metrics.detection`) | `sv.metrics.MeanAveragePrecision` | | `sv.denormalize_boxes(normalized_xyxy=...)` | `sv.denormalize_boxes(xyxy=...)` | | `supervision.dataset.utils.mask_to_rle` / `rle_to_mask` | `sv.mask_to_rle` / `sv.rle_to_mask` | | `ensure_cv2_image_for_annotation` | `ensure_cv2_image_for_class_method` (`supervision.utils.conversion`) | | `ensure_pil_image_for_annotation` | `ensure_pil_image_for_class_method` (`supervision.utils.conversion`) | | `ensure_cv2_image_for_processing` | `ensure_cv2_image_for_standalone_function` (`supervision.utils.conversion`) | | `create_tiles`, `overlay_image` (also `sv.overlay_image`), `validate_keypoint_confidence`, `validate_keypoints_fields` | no direct replacement | ```python # before tracker = sv.ByteTrack() detections = tracker.update_with_detections(detections) map_result = sv.MeanAveragePrecision.from_detections(predictions=predictions, targets=targets) # after from trackers import ByteTrackTracker from supervision.metrics import MeanAveragePrecision detections = ByteTrackTracker().update(detections) map_result = MeanAveragePrecision().update(predictions, targets).compute() ``` Four behaviour changes can alter output: `sv.Detections` raises on non-finite boxes, `sv.CSVSink` writes arrays as JSON lists, `ConfusionMatrix.from_detections` rejects lists of different length, and multi-class `mAR @ K` scores follow COCO. Details under Changed and Fixed. ## 📝 Notable changes ### 🚀 Added - **Depth maps.** `sv.DepthMap`, `sv.DepthAnnotator`, `sv.DepthClipRange` and `sv.DepthCamera`, with `to_depth`, `measure_detections`, `resize`, `crop`, `value_at`, `DepthAnnotator(scale="metric")`, and loaders `from_inference`, `from_ultralytics`, `from_transformers`, `from_png16` and `from_pfm`. (#2691, #2692, #2693, #2694) - **Camera-motion-aware zones.** `PolygonZone.trigger` and `LineZone.trigger` accept `coord_transform`, typed by the new `sv.CoordinatesTransformation` protocol. (#2657) - **COCO keypoint mAP.** `sv.metrics.KeyPointMeanAveragePrecision` for `sv.KeyPoints`, matching `pycocotools` keypoint evaluation. (#2687) - **Configurable mAP detection limits.** Keyword-only `max_detection_thresholds` on `MeanAveragePrecision`; the default `(1, 10, 100)` is unchanged. (#2716) - **Mask confusion matrix.** `sv.ConfusionMatrix.from_detections` and `benchmark` accept `metric_target=MetricTarget.MASKS` and match by mask IoU, on dense masks or `CompactMask`. (#2612) - **Metric result aggregation.** `MetricResult` base class for metric results, plus `aggregate_metric_results()` and `plot_aggregate_metric_results()` to compare several results in one table or grouped bar chart. (#2498) - **Public matcher.** `sv.match_detections` returns one-to-one greedy IoU matches and the unmatched indices on each side, optionally per class. (#2557) - **Kosmos-2.** `sv.VLM.KOSMOS_2` in `sv.Detections.from_vlm`, one detection per grounded region. (#1903) - **Gemini 3.6 and 3.7.** `sv.VLM.GOOGLE_GEMINI_3_6` and `sv.VLM.GOOGLE_GEMINI_3_7` parse the structured `{"boxes": [...]}` format, including normalized polygon masks. (#2504) - **MediaPipe hands.** `sv.KeyPoints.from_mediapipe` loads hand landmarks from the Tasks `HandLandmarker` and the legacy `Hands` solution, with a new hand skeleton, `class_id` 0 for left and 1 for right, and the handedness score in `data["handedness_score"]`. (#2283) ### 🌱 Changed - `sv.Detections` validates `xyxy`: non-finite (NaN, inf) or non-numeric boxes now raise `ValueError` instead of failing later. (#2503) - `sv.ConfusionMatrix.from_detections` raises when `predictions` and `targets` differ in length, instead of scoring the shorter list. (#2612) - `sv.CSVSink` writes NumPy arrays in `data` and `custom_data` as JSON lists instead of NumPy's truncated `str()` form; parse array cells with `json.loads`. (#2707) - `sv.Detections.with_nmm` and `sv.mask_non_max_merge` merge `CompactMask` unions without full-image allocations; the error for mismatched image shapes now names both shapes. (#2606, #2616) - `sv.Detections.from_inference(compact_masks=True)` crops each polygon mask to the polygon instead of the whole image, cutting time and memory for many polygons on large images. (#2678) - COCO greedy matching in `MeanAveragePrecision` and `KeyPointMeanAveragePrecision` is vectorized; results are unchanged. (#2733) - `sv.ComparisonAnnotator` builds its mask union from `CompactMask` crops in place instead of allocating a full `(N, H, W)` stack. (#2495) ### ❌ Removed - APIs deprecated since 0.26.0–0.28.0 and scheduled for 0.31.0: `sv.ByteTrack` and the `supervision.tracker` package (use `trackers.ByteTrackTracker`), the `supervision.keypoint` module (use `supervision.key_points`), `sv.LMM` and `Detections.from_lmm` (use `sv.VLM` and `from_vlm`), the legacy `sv.MeanAveragePrecision` (use `sv.metrics.MeanAveragePrecision`), `create_tiles`, `overlay_image`, `ensure_cv2_image_for_annotation`, `ensure_pil_image_for_annotation` and `ensure_cv2_image_for_processing` (use the `ensure_*_for_class_method` / `ensure_cv2_image_for_standalone_function` decorators), `validate_keypoint_confidence`, `validate_keypoints_fields`, the `normalized_xyxy` argument of `sv.denormalize_boxes` (use `xyxy`), and the `supervision.dataset.utils` import path for `mask_to_rle` / `rle_to_mask`. (#2582) ### 🔧 Fixed - `sv.Detections.from_ultralytics` no longer shifts or truncates segmentation masks when letterbox padding is fractional. (#2739) - Indexing `sv.Detections` with a Python list of booleans now selects list-valued `data` with the same mask as the arrays; it was read as positions. (#2737) - `sv.move_boxes` and `InferenceSlicer` no longer wrap integer coordinates when an offset crosses the dtype's range. (#2734) - `sv.Detections.box_aspect_ratio` no longer overflows on integer boxes at large coordinates. (#2729) - `BlurAnnotator` and `PixelateAnnotator` keep a `(H, W, 1)` grayscale channel axis instead of failing with a broadcasting error. (#2725) - Without OpenCV, thick `line`, `polylines` and `drawContours` outlines match OpenCV's `LINE_8` pixels for `thickness` 2 or more. (#2727) - Without OpenCV, `fillPoly` paints the same boundary pixels as OpenCV, so `polygon_to_mask` and `PolygonZone` agree across backends. (#2730) - Without OpenCV, `resize` with `INTER_NEAREST` samples the same source pixels as OpenCV, which also aligns `sv.CompactMask.resize` across backends. (#2722) - `sv.process_video` stops reading the source when a callback or frame write fails, instead of decoding the rest of the video before raising. (#2720) - Label annotators with `smart_position=True` separate labels whose boxes share a center; before, only the last label was visible. (#2718) - Oriented-box `MeanAveragePrecision` keeps corner precision at large coordinates and puts objects in the right size bucket. (#2717) - `sv.KeyPoints` keeps all three coordinates when selecting a single key point with a NumPy integer index. (#2715) - Integer boxes and oriented boxes no longer land in the wrong object-size category when their area overflows the dtype. (#2713) - `sv.CompactMask` accepts NumPy's `copy` keyword, so NumPy 2 no longer warns on conversion. (#2708) - `sv.CompactMask.resize` matches dense nearest-neighbour resizing, including crops that become empty. (#2697, #2705) - `DetectionDataset.as_yolo`, `as_pascal_voc` and `as_labelme` export a mask with holes as one instance instead of one extra instance per hole; `approximate_mask_with_polygons` in `supervision.dataset.utils` gains the opt-in `bridge_holes` parameter that does this. (#2703) - `sv.metrics.MeanAverageRecall` applies the `mAR @ K` limit per class per image, as COCO does; multi-class scores were too low. (#2701) - `sv.metrics.MeanAveragePrecision` scores perfect predictions as exactly `1.0` instead of 0.99999988. (#2687) - `from_vlm` with Gemini 2.5 or 3.5 keeps a mask pixel only where the score exceeds 127 of 255; masks grew by half a mask pixel per side. (#2589) - `from_vlm` with Gemini 2.5 or 3.5 keeps masks for the detections that pass `classes` when a filtered-out item has no mask. (#2504) - `from_vlm` keeps `class_id` integer-typed when a `classes` filter removes every detection for PaliGemma, DeepSeek-VL2 and Gemini 2.0. (#2556) - `from_ultralytics` for `Detections`, `KeyPoints` and `Classifications` accepts NumPy-backed results, including `Results.numpy()`. (#2710) --- ## 🏆 Contributors - **JANG BYUNGKUN** (@8rulerstar) — added `KeyPointMeanAveragePrecision` and fixed perfect-prediction mAP scoring. - **Caio Viotti** (@cfviotti, [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/caioviotti/)) — added depth support: `DepthMap`, `DepthAnnotator`, `DepthClipRange`, `DepthCamera` and model loaders. - **Kari Pikkarainen** (@kari-pikkarainen, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/karipikkarainen/recent-activity/all/)) — made zones follow camera motion with `coord_transform`. - **Christoph Deil** (@cdeil, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/christophdeil)) — added `max_detection_thresholds` to `MeanAveragePrecision`. - **Raghav Rathi** (@raghav-rathi, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/raghavrathi00/)) — added mask targets to `ConfusionMatrix`. - **shao** (@shaoming11, [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shaoming-wu/)) — added metric-result aggregation and sped up `ComparisonAnnotator` with compact masks. - name: v0.12.1
body:
# v0.12.1

**Every install path works again, and Helm charts join the graph.**

v0.12.1 fixes v0.12.0's package installs and the other install paths we found broken while checking every channel. It also links Helm charts to what they deploy, and stops the graph from inventing a registry for container images.

> **Upgrading?** The first index of each existing project after the upgrade is a full rebuild, once (image identities changed; see below).

## Fixed: installs

- **npm, PyPI and Go installs.** `npm i`, `pnpm add`, `pip install` and the Go wrapper could not install v0.12.0 on any platform. Each wrapper refused an archive member above 256 MiB, and every v0.12.0 binary is 331-335 MB. The size limits are gone from all three wrappers. The archive is still verified against the release's `checksums.txt` before it is unpacked, its contents must be exactly the expected files, and the binary must answer `--version`. Thank you, @hydroplexus, for the precise report (#2657).
- **Homebrew.** The formula was still at 0.10.3, and on Linux it installed the dynamically linked build, which needs glibc 2.38 (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12 and RHEL 9 do not have it). It now installs the current release, and on Linux the static `-portable` build that runs on any distribution.
- **`go install`.** A pinned `go install .../pkg/go/cmd/codebase-memory-mcp@vX.Y.Z` never worked, and `@latest` installed a stale version. Releases now carry `pkg/go/vX.Y.Z` tags, and the wrapper installs the release matching its own version.
- **npm `next`.** The `next` dist-tag no longer points to an old release candidate; a stable release moves it.
- **Docs.** winget and Chocolatey were listed as install channels but are not published; they are removed until they are. Windows arm64 builds ship and are now listed.

**Install-path smoke tests.** Every pull request and every release now installs the npm, PyPI and Go wrappers, the way a user's package manager does, against the real release archives, and runs the binary each one installed. A release is published only after these installs pass, so an installer that cannot install what we ship can no longer reach you.

## Helm charts in the graph

A Helm chart used to be an isolated node. Now it links to what it deploys (#2663):

- **Chart → objects** (`DEPLOYS`, `via: chart`): every Kubernetes object rendered from the chart's `templates/` (a subchart's objects belong to the subchart).
- **values file → Chart** (`CONFIGURES`): `values.yaml` and `values-<x>.yaml` beside `Chart.yaml`.
- **Chart → images** (`DEPLOYS`, `ref: image`): every image its objects name literally (a templated image names none).

`HelmRelease → Chart → Deployment → Image` is now one traversable path. On 20 infrastructure repositories, charts with no outgoing edge dropped from 238 of 260 to 109, and 2,511 chart-to-object links appeared; every other edge stayed identical.

## Images keep the registry the code names

An image without a registry host used to be stored under an invented `docker.io/library/...` (#2654). Docker Hub is only Docker's default: Podman and CRI-O resolve short names through a search list, mirrors rewrite them, and a local build tag may exist on no registry at all. An image now keeps its name as written, with `registry: unknown` when no host is stated; a stated host is kept (Docker Hub's spellings become `docker.io`). `FROM nginx` and `image: docker.io/library/nginx` are now two Image nodes. This changes image identities, which is why each project is rebuilt once after the upgrade.

## Upgrade notes

- The first index of each existing project after the upgrade is a full rebuild, once.
- Image nodes without a stated registry now carry `registry: unknown` and the name as written, instead of `docker.io/library/...`.

body:
Automated release candidate build from `main`.\n\n**npm:** `npm install gitnexus@rc`\n**Version:** `1.6.13-rc.115`\n**Target base:** `1.6.13` (rc #115)\n**Source commit (main):** f8209df2e27fdea2020850d4686ff2bca6a38c16\n**Release commit (versioned tree):** 1ad1acf7d685f67e75252a57910ade7df05898aa\n\nRelease candidates are pre-stable builds intended for early testing. Stable releases remain on the `latest` dist-tag.

<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v1.6.13-rc.115 -->

## What's Changed
### 🚨 Security
* Improve MCP startup compatibility and lazy-load CLI commands by @Shockang in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/207
* test: add integration test coverage and fix KuzuDB fork crashes by @magyargergo in https://github.com/abhigyanpatwari/GitNexus/pull/209
### 🚀 Features

Twenty-three community pull requests: call-resolution and id-collision fixes across JS/TS, Python, Go, Rust and Solidity; graph round-trip, dedup and confidence-folding fixes; skill code-only-update and dispatch fixes; and LLM/Ollama and detection fixes. The AST cache schema is bumped, so the first build after upgrading re-extracts.

- Fix: **JS/TS** class members differing only by `_`, `$` or `#` are kept as separate nodes (#4475, #4479, thanks @Mpasha17).
- Fix: **TypeScript** `this.field` is typed from an assignment in any method, including `static` and accessors (#4473, #4482, thanks @FolatheDuckofDuckingburg).
- Fix: **JS** a workspace package whose `exports` points only into `dist/` falls back to `src/` (#4485, #4489, thanks @bercedev).
- Fix: **JS** a dangling barrel-named import edge is dropped once the import resolves through the barrel (#4486, #4488, thanks @bercedev).
- Fix: **Python** module-level class ids colliding with a function or class are salted apart (#2810, #4467, thanks @hementhu).
- Feature: **Python** a member call on a pytest fixture parameter is typed from the fixture's returned class (#4332, #4333, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **Go / Rust** same-file declarations differing only by case are kept as separate nodes (#4468, thanks @abdulsamie10).
- Feature: **Solidity** inherited calls, `super` calls and modifiers resolve through C3 linearization (#4379, #4384, thanks @rohit-jsfreaky).
- Fix: **MCP** parallel edges are preserved through the graph.json round-trip and query output (#4500, #4503, thanks @rtmalikian).
- Fix: **dedup** a node with a source_file beats a sourceless namesake in collision rank (#4492, #4496, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **build** model-drifted string confidences fold to a valid value before validation and dedup (#4495, #4501, thanks @ayushcodes10).
- Fix: **extractors** the in-flight scan root is shared via the extractors base module, restoring the one-way import direction (#3666, #3758, thanks @abhay-codes07).
- Fix: **detect** only a valid `.git` is treated as a VCS root, so a stray home-dir `.git` no longer leaks its .gitignore (#4444, #4464, thanks @Mpasha17).
- Fix: **hooks** post-merge rebuilds on real merges, and a new post-rewrite hook rebuilds after cherry-pick/rebase/`pull --rebase` (#4463, #4476; #4490, #4491, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **skill** the code-only `--update` path materializes the extraction before the merge across all hosts (#4447, #4313, thanks @vibhanshu-mishra; aider/devin #4456, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **skill** stray backticks inside a double-quoted `-c` block no longer run a command mid-step (#4461, #4462, thanks @Deepjyoti-Sarmah).
- Fix: **skill** Pi dispatches semantic subagents to the native `delegate` agent (#4494, #4502, thanks @bercedev).
- Fix: **skill** the agent pushes to the exact Neo4j/FalkorDB URI supplied, not a localhost example (#4349, thanks @vibhanshu-mishra).
- Fix: **llm** the extraction prompt pins source_file to the dispatched file (#3377, #2270, #4487, thanks @cornwe19).
- Feature: **llm** opt-in backend selection via `GRAPHIFY_BACKEND`, a disable switch, and an honest auto-detect (#4361, #4376, thanks @nothariharan).

name: v0.8.0-alpha.3
body:
## Highlights

- **Security updates.** Dependencies with RustSec advisories are updated, including rustls 0.23.46, h2 0.4.20 (DoS against fullstack servers) and webbrowser 1.2.4. The minimum versions of rustls, webbrowser and plist are raised so downstream projects can't resolve to vulnerable releases (#5938). The discontinued `async-std` is removed from examples and tests (#5939).
- **Desktop and mobile on tao 0.37 / wry 0.57** (#5936). On Android, toggling dark mode, font scale, density and similar settings no longer re-creates the activity and leaves a blank webview. `manganis::android::with_activity` now tracks the current activity instead of caching the first one.
- **Native:** `NodeHandle` methods such as `set_focus`, `scroll_to` and `get_client_rect` no longer panic with a `RefCell` double borrow when called from tasks, effects or component bodies during a render. Mutations are now buffered and applied after the VirtualDOM runs, as on web and desktop (#5943). `use dioxus_native::prelude::*` now includes everything `rsx!` needs, so the `cannot find module html` errors from alpha.2 are gone (#5927).
- **Web logging in `dx serve`:** web app logs are now plain text at their real level, so DEBUG is hidden unless verbose is on and the stray `%c` markers are gone (#5921). Signal and memo creation no longer adds a span to the browser's performance buffer in debug builds (#5930).
- **Core:** fixed placement of fragment siblings, a regression from #5554 (#5924, by @rdeaton).
- **`dx new` / `dx init`:** cargo-generate 0.25 (#5944). `dx new --yes` without `--subtemplate` picks the first sub-template instead of failing with `not a terminal`, and hook scripts are no longer left in the generated project. Inside an existing workspace, `dx new` no longer duplicates members already covered by a glob (#5947), no longer adds a project that has its own `[workspace]` to the outer workspace (#5948), and no longer reformats the root manifest.
- **`dx translate --component`** no longer emits a stray `)` (#5926, by @toastmod, their first contribution).
- **Dependency upgrades and cleanup:** reqwest 0.13 with a single tungstenite 0.29 (#5935), blitz 0.3.0-beta.4 and keyboard-types 0.8 (#5934), toml 1.1 / toml_edit 0.25 / cargo_toml 1.0 (#5937), ratatui 0.30 (#5954), gloo-net 0.7 (#5957), gloo-timers 0.4, and lightningcss without its unused default features (#5942). Many duplicate crate versions are gone from the tree.
- **docs.rs:** `dioxus-server` documentation builds again; it had failed since 0.7.10 (#5923).

## Breaking changes

- **keyboard-types 0.8** (#5934): named keys moved to a separate enum, so `Key::Enter` becomes `Key::Named(NamedKey::Enter)`. `NamedKey` is re-exported next to `Key` from `dioxus::prelude`, `dioxus-html` and `dioxus_native::prelude`.
- **Custom renderers** (#5945): `WriteMutations::set_attribute` now takes `BorrowedAttributeValue<'_>` instead of `&AttributeValue`. `Text` borrows a `&str`, and there is no `Listener` variant.
- **`dioxus-desktop`** (#5934, #5936): the `linux-libxdo` feature is removed, because muda and tray-icon no longer use libxdo, and `libxdo-dev` is no longer needed on Linux. The `transparent` and `fullscreen` features are kept but now do nothing (wry always enables them). In the re-exported tao, `Event::Suspended`/`Resumed` moved to `WindowEvent`. tao and wry now use `windows` 0.62, which drops Windows 7.
- **Fullstack, native targets** (#5935): `dioxus::launch` installs ring as the process-wide rustls crypto provider unless one is already installed. To use a different provider, install it before calling `launch`. `axum-server` is now 0.8 and `axum-extra` 0.12.
- **Fullstack, web** (#5957): `ClientRequest::new_gloo_request` returns a gloo-net 0.7 `RequestBuilder`.
- **Native** (#5943): code that runs during a render now sees the document as it was before that render, as on web.
- **Android** (#5936): `manganis::android::with_activity` returns `None` when no activity has been set.

## Known issues

- **`dx components` doesn't work in this release.** `dx components list`, `add` and `update` fail with `there is no TLS stream available`. #5944 moved to cargo-generate 0.25, which no longer enables HTTPS in the `git2` (libgit2) build that `dx components` uses to clone the registry. Separately, `dx components add` adds `dioxus-primitives` from the components repo's default branch, which still targets Dioxus 0.7, so it can't resolve in a 0.8 project (this also affects alpha.2). `dx new`, `dx serve` and `dx bundle` are unaffected. Both will be fixed in the next alpha.

  **Workaround:** copy the components you need from the [`0.8` branch of the components repo](https://github.com/DioxusLabs/components/tree/0.8/preview/src/components) into your project, along with [`dx-components-theme.css`](https://github.com/DioxusLabs/components/blob/0.8/preview/assets/dx-components-theme.css), and depend on the primitives from that branch:
  ```toml
  dioxus-primitives = { git = "https://github.com/DioxusLabs/components", branch = "0.8", default-features = false }
  ```

## What's Changed
* dioxus-server: drop stale docs.rs features so docs build again by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5923
* dioxus-native: re-export `html` and element prelude from `prelude` by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5927
* fix(cli): Remove ')' from `dx translate --component` by @toastmod in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5926
* Add release-alpha agent skill by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5928
* signals: record signal and memo spans at trace level by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5930
* Replace `tracing-wasm` with a custom implementation by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5921
* fix(core): read fragment siblings through their current mount views d… by @rdeaton in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5924
* Upgrade `global-hotkey`, `muda`,`tray-icon`,`keyboard-types`, and `zip` by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5934
* Upgrade reqwest to 0.13, unify tungstenite on 0.29, bump axum companions by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5935
* Upgrade toml to 1.1, toml_edit to 0.25 and cargo_toml to 1.0 by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5937
* Update dependencies with security advisories by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5938
* Drop libxdo-dev, replace async-std in examples, bump gloo-timers by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5939
* Upgrade tao to 0.37 and wry to 0.57 by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5936
* ci: prune stale cargo artifacts before saving caches, and only save caches on main by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5950
* core: pass a borrowed attribute value to `WriteMutations::set_attribute` by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5945
* dx new: don't add a workspace member already covered by a glob by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5947
* dx new: don't add a workspace-root project to an outer workspace by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5948
* native: buffer mutations and apply them after the vdom has run by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5943
* Upgrade cargo-generate to 0.25.0 and console-subscriber to 0.5.0 by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5944
* Trim lightningcss features and upgrade sqlx to 0.9 in examples by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5942
* Upgrade ratatui to 0.30 and related TUI crates by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5954
* CI: Use local cache action. Cache Windows via GitHub by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5951
* CI: Don't rerun CI for a PR title/description edit by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5956
* Upgrade gloo-net to 0.7 by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5957
* Bump versions for 0.8.0-alpha.3 release by @nicoburns in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5958

## New Contributors
* @toastmod made their first contribution in https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/pull/5926

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DioxusLabs/dioxus/compare/v0.8.0-alpha.2...v0.8.0-alpha.3

name: v1.4.229
body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

## The short version

- **Native chat (experimental):** Review turn-by-turn edits inline, expand diagrams to pan and zoom, share chat visuals with a click, and see Claude goals and Codex context usage. Keyboard answers, an unread divider and Copy on Select make long conversations easier to navigate.
- **Shared skills:** Shared-skill installation now supports 20 additional agents, with broader WSL discovery and the right install locations for tools such as Kiro, Qoder and CodeBuddy.
- **Phone:** Workspace filters, grouping and sorting now follow the desktop’s shared choices. Long-press for linked issues and notes, work with server workspaces and browser pages, or continue a supported chat in a new terminal conversation.
- **SSH and remote terminals:** Reconnect fixes preserve split panes, paste order and managed-server project groups. Sleeping agents resume their conversations, and removing one machine’s project leaves its same-path counterpart alone.
- **Workspaces and everyday polish:** Open a website from Cmd/Ctrl+J, watch checkout progress as a worktree is created, and clean up workspaces with an explicit confirmation before stopping running agents.
- **Jira planning:** Switch between issue lists and boards, focus on the current sprint, reuse saved JQL and Jira favourites, and start workspaces from desktop or phone. Your agents can read and update Jira tickets through the Orca CLI, too.

## Known issues

**Native chat (experimental):** Features that depend on a remote host are available when that host supports them. Update the host alongside Orca to get the latest capabilities.

**The `orca` command on SSH hosts:** Existing hosts keep their saved Orca CLI control preference. To let agents there manage workspaces or control the desktop browser, turn on **Allow this host’s orca CLI to control Orca** under Settings → SSH Hosts → edit the host → Advanced Connection.

---

## Product experience

### Automations

*Create and edit automations on SSH projects with older paired servers, and keep scheduled work attached to the right host.*

name: Orca Mobile Android mobile-android-v0.0.57
body:
Thank you for using Orca mobile! ❤️

## What's new

- Downloading the latest app from your computer keeps going over slow connections, such as Tailscale or a weak signal, instead of failing partway.
- Opening a workspace no longer downloads the app again when nothing has changed on your computer.

Most phone features come from your desktop, so update Orca on your computer to get everything. See the [desktop release notes](https://github.com/stablyai/orca/releases) for the full list.
